export async function queryFirst<T = unknown>(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<T | null> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  return (await stmt.first<T>()) ?? null;
}

export async function queryAll<T = unknown>(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<T[]> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  const result = await stmt.all<T>();
  return (result.results ?? []) as T[];
}

export async function run(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<D1Result> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  return await stmt.run();
}

@'
// Raymond Worker entry point.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import { cors } from "hono/cors";
import type { Env } from "./core/db";
import { registry } from "./core/registry";
import { aiChatCapability, setEnv } from "./capabilities/ai-chat";
import { chatRoutes } from "./routes/chat";
import { systemRoutes } from "./routes/system";
import { authRoutes } from "./routes/auth";
import { telegramRoutes } from "./routes/telegram";
import { telegramWsRoutes } from "./routes/telegram-ws";
import { initRuntime } from "./runtime";
import { requireAuth } from "./middleware/require-auth";

// Durable Object export (must be a top-level export)
export { TelegramProxy } from "./do/telegram-proxy";

type Bindings = Env;
const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Bindings }>();

// CORS — allow credentials for cookie-based auth
app.use(
  "*",
  cors({
    origin: (origin) => origin,
    credentials: true,
  })
);

// Disable caching for HTML/JS/CSS so updates show immediately
app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
  await next();
  const path = new URL(c.req.url).pathname;
  if (
    path === "/" ||
    path.endsWith(".html") ||
    path.endsWith(".js") ||
    path.endsWith(".css")
  ) {
    c.res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate");
    c.res.headers.set("Pragma", "no-cache");
    c.res.headers.set("Expires", "0");
  }
});

// Init runtime + set env per request
app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
  initRuntime(c.env);
  setEnv(c.env);
  await next();
});

// ===== Telegram WebSocket relay (NO auth — GramJS handles auth) =====
app.route("/tg", telegramWsRoutes);

// ===== Auth API (public) =====
app.route("/api/auth", authRoutes);

// ===== Everything under /api/* is auth-gated =====
app.use("/api/*", requireAuth());

app.route("/api/chat", chatRoutes);
app.route("/api/system", systemRoutes);
app.route("/api/telegram", telegramRoutes);

app.get("/api", (c) => {
  return c.json({
    app: c.env.APP_NAME ?? "Raymond",
    version: "0.3.0",
  });
});

app.all("/api/*", (c) => c.json({ error: "Not found" }, 404));

let bootstrapped = false;
async function bootstrap(env: Env): Promise<void> {
  if (bootstrapped) return;
  bootstrapped = true;
  registry.register(aiChatCapability.manifest);
  aiChatCapability.register();
  try {
    await registry.syncToDb(env);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Registry sync failed:", err);
  }
}

// Static assets fallback (SPA)
app.all("*", async (c) => {
  return c.env.ASSETS.fetch(c.req.raw);
});

export default {
  async fetch(
    request: Request,
    env: Env,
    ctx: ExecutionContext
  ): Promise<Response> {
    await bootstrap(env);
    initRuntime(env);
    setEnv(env);
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
} satisfies ExportedHandler<Env>;

# 1) GramJS WebSocket client
# ============================================================
@'
// GramJS client — runs in the browser, connects to Telegram via our
// Worker relay at /tg/apiws.
//
// Sessions are stored in IndexedDB (auto). Multiple accounts are supported
// by using multiple sessions with distinct IDs.

import { TelegramClient } from "telegram";
import { StringSession } from "telegram/sessions";
import { Api } from "telegram";

// API credentials — you must create your own at https://my.telegram.org
// For now we use the well-known public ones (same as tweb uses publicly).
// You SHOULD replace these with your own later.
const API_ID = 2040;
const API_HASH = "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627";

const RELAY_BASE = `${location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws"}://${location.host}/tg/apiws`;

// Map GramJS dcId (1..5) to relay dc param
function relayUrlForDc(dcId: number): string {
  return `${RELAY_BASE}?dc=${dcId}`;
}

export interface TgSessionInfo {
  id: string;
  phone: string;
  username?: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  userId?: string;
  authState: "authorized" | "needs_code" | "needs_password" | "offline";
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "raymond_tg_sessions_v1";

// We store all accounts' sessions as JSON (base64-encoded StringSession)
interface StoredSession {
  id: string;
  sessionString: string;
  info: TgSessionInfo;
}

function loadStoredSessions(): StoredSession[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveStoredSessions(list: StoredSession[]): void {
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
}

export class TgManager {
  private clients = new Map<string, TelegramClient>();
  private sessions: StoredSession[] = [];

  constructor() {
    this.sessions = loadStoredSessions();
  }

  listAccounts(): TgSessionInfo[] {
    return this.sessions.map((s) => s.info);
  }

  getClient(sessionId: string): TelegramClient | null {
    return this.clients.get(sessionId) ?? null;
  }

  /**
   * Start a new login: opens WebSocket, sends code to phone.
   * Returns the session ID assigned to this pending login.
   */
  async startLogin(phone: string): Promise<{ sessionId: string; phoneCodeHash: string }> {
    const sessionId = `tg_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;

    const client = new TelegramClient(
      new StringSession(""),
      API_ID,
      API_HASH,
      {
        connectionRetries: 3,
        useWSS: true,
        // Route WS to our relay:
        baseLogger: undefined,
      }
    );

    // Override the default connection with our relay
    // GramJS accepts a custom transport via `connection` — but easiest is
    // to patch the DC WebSocket URLs. GramJS exposes MTProtoSender with
    // dc config; here we use a simpler approach: set `_initParams`.
    await client.connect();

    const result = await client.invoke(
      new Api.auth.SendCode({
        phoneNumber: phone,
        apiId: API_ID,
        apiHash: API_HASH,
        settings: new Api.CodeSettings({}),
      })
    );

    // GramJS may wrap; fallback to checking result directly
    const phoneCodeHash =
      (result as unknown as { phoneCodeHash?: string }).phoneCodeHash ?? "";

    // Save pending client in memory; session string will be saved after full auth
    this.pendingClients.set(sessionId, { client, phone });

    return { sessionId, phoneCodeHash };
  }

  private pendingClients = new Map<string, { client: TelegramClient; phone: string }>();

  /**
   * Complete login with the code the user received.
   * If 2FA is enabled, this throws a special error with .needs2FA = true.
   */
  async completeLogin(
    sessionId: string,
    code: string,
    password?: string
  ): Promise<TgSessionInfo> {
    const pending = this.pendingClients.get(sessionId);
    if (!pending) throw new Error("Login session not found");
    const { client, phone } = pending;

    try {
      await client.signIn({
        phoneNumber: phone,
        phoneCode: async () => code,
        password: async () => password ?? "",
        onError: (err: Error) => { throw err; },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const e = err as Error & { errorMessage?: string };
      if (e.errorMessage === "SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED") {
        // 2FA required
        if (!password) {
          const error = new Error("2FA password required");
          (error as Error & { needs2FA?: boolean }).needs2FA = true;
          throw error;
        }
      }
      throw err;
    }

    const me = await client.getMe();

    // Persist session
    const sessionString = (client.session as StringSession).save();
    const info: TgSessionInfo = {
      id: sessionId,
      phone,
      username: (me as Api.User).username ?? undefined,
      firstName: (me as Api.User).firstName ?? undefined,
      lastName: (me as Api.User).lastName ?? undefined,
      userId: me.id?.toString(),
      authState: "authorized",
    };

    this.sessions.push({ id: sessionId, sessionString, info });
    saveStoredSessions(this.sessions);
    this.clients.set(sessionId, client);
    this.pendingClients.delete(sessionId);

    return info;
  }

  /**
   * Restore all saved sessions on app start.
   */
  async restoreAll(): Promise<TgSessionInfo[]> {
    const restored: TgSessionInfo[] = [];
    for (const stored of this.sessions) {
      try {
        const client = new TelegramClient(
          new StringSession(stored.sessionString),
          API_ID,
          API_HASH,
          { connectionRetries: 3, useWSS: true }
        );
        await client.connect();
        this.clients.set(stored.id, client);
        restored.push(stored.info);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to restore session", stored.id, err);
      }
    }
    return restored;
  }

  async logout(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const client = this.clients.get(sessionId);
    if (client) {
      try { await client.logOut(); } catch {}
      try { await client.disconnect(); } catch {}
    }
    this.clients.delete(sessionId);
    this.sessions = this.sessions.filter((s) => s.id !== sessionId);
    saveStoredSessions(this.sessions);
  }
}

// Singleton
export const tgManager = new TgManager();

@'
// Polyfills for GramJS in the browser.
// GramJS is written for Node.js, so we provide browser equivalents.

import { Buffer } from "buffer";
import process from "process";

// Expose globals
(globalThis as unknown as { Buffer: typeof Buffer }).Buffer = Buffer;
(globalThis as unknown as { process: typeof process }).process = process;
(globalThis as unknown as { global: typeof globalThis }).global = globalThis;

// Simple EventEmitter fallback (GramJS uses events)
if (typeof (globalThis as unknown as { Event?: unknown }).Event === "undefined") {
  class SimpleEvent {
    type: string;
    constructor(type: string) { this.type = type; }
  }
  (globalThis as unknown as { Event: typeof SimpleEvent }).Event = SimpleEvent;
}

export {};

@'
// GramJS client — real MTProto via our Worker relay.
//
// Connects the browser directly to Telegram through /tg/apiws.
// Sessions are stored in localStorage (multi-account supported).

import { TelegramClient } from "telegram";
import { StringSession } from "telegram/sessions";
import { Api } from "telegram";

// API credentials — same public ones used by Telegram Web K.
// Replace with your own from https://my.telegram.org if you want.
const API_ID = 2040;
const API_HASH = "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627";

// WebSocket relay to the Worker Durable Object.
const RELAY_URL = `${location.protocol === "https:" ? "wss" : "ws"}://${location.host}/tg/apiws`;

// Patch GramJS's default WebSocket to use our relay.
// GramJS calls: new WebSocket(url) — we override to rewrite the URL.
const OriginalWebSocket = window.WebSocket;
class RelayWebSocket extends OriginalWebSocket {
  constructor(url: string | URL, protocols?: string | string[]) {
    const dcMatch = String(url).match(/\/(\d+)\/?$/);
    const dc = dcMatch ? dcMatch[1] : "2";
    const relay = `${RELAY_URL}?dc=${dc}`;
    super(relay, protocols as string | string[] | undefined);
  }
}
// Install globally so GramJS picks it up.
(window as unknown as { WebSocket: typeof WebSocket }).WebSocket = RelayWebSocket as unknown as typeof WebSocket;

export interface TgSessionInfo {
  id: string;
  phone: string;
  username?: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  userId?: string;
  authState: "authorized" | "needs_code" | "needs_password" | "offline";
}

interface StoredSession {
  id: string;
  sessionString: string;
  info: TgSessionInfo;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "raymond_tg_sessions_v1";

function loadStored(): StoredSession[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return JSON.parse(raw) as StoredSession[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveStored(list: StoredSession[]): void {
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
}

export class TgManager {
  private clients = new Map<string, TelegramClient>();
  private sessions: StoredSession[] = loadStored();
  private pending = new Map<string, { client: TelegramClient; phone: string }>();

  listAccounts(): TgSessionInfo[] {
    return this.sessions.map((s) => s.info);
  }

  async startLogin(phone: string): Promise<{ sessionId: string }> {
    const sessionId = "tg_" + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    const client = new TelegramClient(new StringSession(""), API_ID, API_HASH, {
      connectionRetries: 3,
      useWSS: true,
    });
    await client.connect();

    await client.sendCode({ apiId: API_ID, apiHash: API_HASH }, phone);
    this.pending.set(sessionId, { client, phone });
    return { sessionId };
  }

  async completeLogin(
    sessionId: string,
    code: string,
    password?: string
  ): Promise<TgSessionInfo> {
    const p = this.pending.get(sessionId);
    if (!p) throw new Error("Login session expired");

    try {
      await p.client.signIn({
        phoneNumber: p.phone,
        phoneCode: async () => code,
        password: async () => password ?? "",
        onError: (e: Error) => { throw e; },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const e = err as Error & { errorMessage?: string };
      if (e.errorMessage === "SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED") {
        const error = new Error("2FA password required");
        (error as Error & { needs2FA?: boolean }).needs2FA = true;
        throw error;
      }
      throw err;
    }

    const me = (await p.client.getMe()) as Api.User;
    const sessionString = (p.client.session as StringSession).save();

    const info: TgSessionInfo = {
      id: sessionId,
      phone: p.phone,
      username: me.username ?? undefined,
      firstName: me.firstName ?? undefined,
      lastName: me.lastName ?? undefined,
      userId: me.id?.toString(),
      authState: "authorized",
    };

    this.sessions.push({ id: sessionId, sessionString, info });
    saveStored(this.sessions);
    this.clients.set(sessionId, p.client);
    this.pending.delete(sessionId);

    return info;
  }

  async restoreAll(): Promise<TgSessionInfo[]> {
    const restored: TgSessionInfo[] = [];
    for (const s of this.sessions) {
      try {
        const client = new TelegramClient(
          new StringSession(s.sessionString),
          API_ID,
          API_HASH,
          { connectionRetries: 3, useWSS: true }
        );
        await client.connect();
        this.clients.set(s.id, client);
        restored.push(s.info);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to restore", s.id, err);
      }
    }
    return restored;
  }

  async logout(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const client = this.clients.get(sessionId);
    if (client) {
      try { await client.logOut(); } catch {}
      try { await client.disconnect(); } catch {}
    }
    this.clients.delete(sessionId);
    this.sessions = this.sessions.filter((s) => s.id !== sessionId);
    saveStored(this.sessions);
  }
}

export const tgManager = new TgManager();

type GramJsModule = {
  TelegramClient: new (
    session: unknown,
    apiId: number,
    apiHash: string,
    opts: Record<string, unknown>
  ) => GramJsClient;
  StringSession: new (str: string) => { save: () => string };
  Api: Record<string, unknown>;
};

type GramJsClient = {
  connect: () => Promise<void>;
  sendCode: (opts: { apiId: number; apiHash: string }, phone: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  signIn: (opts: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>;
  getMe: () => Promise<{ id?: unknown; username?: string; firstName?: string; lastName?: string }>;
  logOut: () => Promise<void>;
  disconnect: () => Promise<void>;
  session: { save: () => string };
};

const API_ID = 2040;
const API_HASH = "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627";

let gramjsPromise: Promise<GramJsModule> | null = null;

async function loadGramJs(): Promise<GramJsModule> {
  if (!gramjsPromise) {
    // Apply polyfills BEFORE importing GramJS
    await import("./polyfills");
    gramjsPromise = (async () => {
      const mod = (await import("telegram")) as unknown as {
        TelegramClient: GramJsModule["TelegramClient"];
        Api: GramJsModule["Api"];
      };
      const sessions = (await import("telegram/sessions")) as unknown as {
        StringSession: GramJsModule["StringSession"];
      };
      return {
        TelegramClient: mod.TelegramClient,
        StringSession: sessions.StringSession,
        Api: mod.Api,
      };
    })();
  }
  return gramjsPromise;
}

# ============================================================
# 1) Login UI component

@'
import { useState } from "react";
import { tgManager, type TgSessionInfo } from "../../lib/telegram/client";

interface Props {
  onComplete: (info: TgSessionInfo) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

type Step = "phone" | "code" | "password" | "loading";

export function TgLoginScreen({ onComplete, onCancel }: Props) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("phone");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const startLogin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setStep("loading");
    try {
      const { sessionId: sid } = await tgManager.startLogin(phone);
      setSessionId(sid);
      setStep("code");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
      setStep("phone");
    }
  };

  const submitCode = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!sessionId) return;
    setError(null);
    setStep("loading");
    try {
      const info = await tgManager.completeLogin(sessionId, code);
      onComplete(info);
    } catch (err) {
      const e2 = err as Error & { needs2FA?: boolean };
      if (e2.needs2FA) {
        setStep("password");
        return;
      }
      setError(e2.message);
      setStep("code");
    }
  };

  const submitPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!sessionId) return;
    setError(null);
    setStep("loading");
    try {
      const info = await tgManager.completeLogin(sessionId, code, password);
      onComplete(info);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
      setStep("password");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="auth-wrap">
      <div className="auth-card">
        <div className="auth-logo">
          <span className="brand-dot" />
          <span>Telegram Login</span>
        </div>

        {step === "phone" && (
          <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={startLogin}>
            <div className="auth-subtitle">
              Enter your phone number (with country code)
            </div>
            <div className="auth-field">
              <label>Phone</label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                placeholder="+98 912 345 6789"
                value={phone}
                onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                autoFocus
                required
              />
            </div>
            {error && <div className="auth-error">{error}</div>}
            <button className="auth-btn" type="submit">
              Send code
            </button>
            <div className="auth-link" onClick={onCancel}>
              ← Cancel
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

        {step === "code" && (
          <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submitCode}>
            <div className="auth-subtitle">
              We sent a code to your Telegram app.
              <br />
              Enter the code below.
            </div>
            <div className="auth-field">
              <label>Code</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                inputMode="numeric"
                placeholder="12345"
                value={code}
                onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                autoFocus
                required
              />
            </div>
            {error && <div className="auth-error">{error}</div>}
            <button className="auth-btn" type="submit">
              Sign in
            </button>
          </form>
        )}

        {step === "password" && (
          <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submitPassword}>
            <div className="auth-subtitle">
              Two-factor authentication is enabled.
              <br />
              Enter your Telegram password.
            </div>
            <div className="auth-field">
              <label>2FA Password</label>
              <input
                type="password"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                autoFocus
                required
              />
            </div>
            {error && <div className="auth-error">{error}</div>}
            <button className="auth-btn" type="submit">
              Confirm
            </button>
          </form>
        )}

        {step === "loading" && (
          <div className="auth-subtitle" style={{ padding: "20px 0" }}>
            Connecting to Telegram...
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

# 2) GramJS chat loader (uses real TelegramClient)

@'
// Telegram chat loader — pulls real chats/messages via GramJS.

import { tgManager } from "../../lib/telegram/client";

export interface TgChatReal {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  type: "user" | "group" | "channel" | "bot";
  unreadCount: number;
  lastMessageAt: number;
  lastMessagePreview: string;
  pinned: boolean;
}

export interface TgMessageReal {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  date: number;
  outgoing: boolean;
  senderName: string;
}

export async function loadRealChats(sessionId: string): Promise<TgChatReal[]> {
  const client = (tgManager as unknown as {
    clients: Map<string, unknown>;
  }).clients.get(sessionId);
  if (!client) throw new Error("Session not connected");

  const c = client as {
    getDialogs: (opts: { limit: number }) => Promise<unknown[]>;
  };

  const dialogs = await c.getDialogs({ limit: 50 });

  const chats: TgChatReal[] = [];
  for (const d of dialogs) {
    const dlg = d as {
      id?: { toString: () => string };
      title?: string;
      name?: string;
      unreadCount?: number;
      date?: number;
      message?: { message?: string };
      isUser?: boolean;
      isGroup?: boolean;
      isChannel?: boolean;
      entity?: { bot?: boolean };
      pinned?: boolean;
    };

    let type: TgChatReal["type"] = "user";
    if (dlg.isGroup) type = "group";
    else if (dlg.isChannel) type = "channel";
    else if (dlg.entity?.bot) type = "bot";

    chats.push({
      id: dlg.id?.toString() ?? "",
      title: dlg.title ?? dlg.name ?? "(unnamed)",
      type,
      unreadCount: dlg.unreadCount ?? 0,
      lastMessageAt: (dlg.date ?? 0) * 1000,
      lastMessagePreview: dlg.message?.message ?? "",
      pinned: !!dlg.pinned,
    });
  }

  return chats;
}

export async function loadRealMessages(
  sessionId: string,
  chatId: string
): Promise<TgMessageReal[]> {
  const client = (tgManager as unknown as {
    clients: Map<string, unknown>;
  }).clients.get(sessionId);
  if (!client) throw new Error("Session not connected");

  const c = client as {
    getMessages: (
      entity: unknown,
      opts: { limit: number }
    ) => Promise<unknown[]>;
    getEntity: (id: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  };

  const entity = await c.getEntity(chatId);
  const msgs = await c.getMessages(entity, { limit: 50 });

  return msgs.map((m) => {
    const msg = m as {
      id?: number;
      message?: string;
      date?: number;
      out?: boolean;
      senderId?: { toString: () => string };
    };
    return {
      id: String(msg.id ?? ""),
      text: msg.message ?? "",
      date: (msg.date ?? 0) * 1000,
      outgoing: !!msg.out,
      senderName: msg.out ? "You" : "Them",
    };
  }).reverse();
}

export async function sendRealMessage(
  sessionId: string,
  chatId: string,
  text: string
): Promise<void> {
  const client = (tgManager as unknown as {
    clients: Map<string, unknown>;
  }).clients.get(sessionId);
  if (!client) throw new Error("Session not connected");

  const c = client as {
    sendMessage: (entity: unknown, opts: { message: string }) => Promise<unknown>;
    getEntity: (id: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  };

  const entity = await c.getEntity(chatId);
  await c.sendMessage(entity, { message: text });
}

@'
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { tgManager, type TgSessionInfo } from "../../lib/telegram/client";
import { TgLoginScreen } from "./TgLoginScreen";
import {
  loadRealChats,
  loadRealMessages,
  sendRealMessage,
  type TgChatReal,
  type TgMessageReal,
} from "./real-chats";

export function MessengerApp() {
  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState<TgSessionInfo[]>([]);
  const [activeAccount, setActiveAccount] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [chats, setChats] = useState<TgChatReal[]>([]);
  const [activeChat, setActiveChat] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<TgMessageReal[]>([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const [showAccounts, setShowAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [showLogin, setShowLogin] = useState(false);
  const [loadingChats, setLoadingChats] = useState(false);
  const [loadingMessages, setLoadingMessages] = useState(false);

  // Restore sessions on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const restored = await tgManager.restoreAll();
        setAccounts(restored);
        if (restored.length > 0) setActiveAccount(restored[0].id);
        else setShowLogin(true);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("restoreAll failed:", e);
        setShowLogin(true);
      }
    })();
  }, []);

  // Load chats when account changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeAccount) return;
    setLoadingChats(true);
    setChats([]);
    setActiveChat(null);
    setMessages([]);
    (async () => {
      try {
        const list = await loadRealChats(activeAccount);
        setChats(list);
        if (list.length > 0) setActiveChat(list[0].id);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("loadRealChats failed:", e);
      } finally {
        setLoadingChats(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [activeAccount]);

  // Load messages when chat changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeAccount || !activeChat) return;
    setLoadingMessages(true);
    (async () => {
      try {
        const list = await loadRealMessages(activeAccount, activeChat);
        setMessages(list);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("loadRealMessages failed:", e);
      } finally {
        setLoadingMessages(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [activeAccount, activeChat]);

  const send = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!activeAccount || !activeChat || !draft.trim()) return;
    const text = draft.trim();
    setDraft("");

    // Optimistic
    const temp: TgMessageReal = {
      id: "temp_" + Date.now(),
      text,
      date: Date.now(),
      outgoing: true,
      senderName: "You",
    };
    setMessages((p) => [...p, temp]);

    try {
      await sendRealMessage(activeAccount, activeChat, text);
      // Reload messages to get the real one
      const refreshed = await loadRealMessages(activeAccount, activeChat);
      setMessages(refreshed);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("sendRealMessage failed:", e);
    }
  }, [activeAccount, activeChat, draft]);

  const handleLoginComplete = (info: TgSessionInfo) => {
    setAccounts((p) => [...p, info]);
    setActiveAccount(info.id);
    setShowLogin(false);
  };

  const logoutAccount = async (id: string) => {
    await tgManager.logout(id);
    const remaining = accounts.filter((a) => a.id !== id);
    setAccounts(remaining);
    if (activeAccount === id) {
      setActiveAccount(remaining[0]?.id ?? null);
      setChats([]);
      setMessages([]);
    }
    setShowAccounts(false);
  };

  if (showLogin) {
    return (
      <TgLoginScreen
        onComplete={handleLoginComplete}
        onCancel={() => setShowLogin(false)}
      />
    );
  }

  const activeChatObj = chats.find((c) => c.id === activeChat);
  const activeAccountObj = accounts.find((a) => a.id === activeAccount);

  return (
    <div className={`messenger ${activeChat ? "has-active-chat" : ""}`}>
      {/* Chats column */}
      <div className="messenger-chats">
        <div className="messenger-chats-header">
          <button
            className="messenger-account-btn"
            onClick={() => setShowAccounts((v) => !v)}
            title="Switch account"
          >
            <span className="messenger-account-avatar">
              {(activeAccountObj?.firstName?.[0] ?? "?").toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <span className="messenger-account-name">
              {activeAccountObj?.firstName ?? "No account"}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "var(--text-dim)" }}>▼</span>
          </button>

          {showAccounts && (
            <div className="messenger-accounts-dropdown">
              {accounts.map((a) => (
                <div
                  key={a.id}
                  className={`messenger-account-item ${
                    a.id === activeAccount ? "active" : ""
                  }`}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActiveAccount(a.id);
                    setShowAccounts(false);
                  }}
                >
                  <span className="messenger-account-avatar">
                    {(a.firstName?.[0] ?? "?").toUpperCase()}
                  </span>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                    <div className="messenger-account-name">
                      {a.firstName ?? a.username ?? a.phone}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "var(--text-dim)" }}>
                      {a.phone}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    className="conv-delete"
                    style={{ opacity: 1 }}
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      logoutAccount(a.id);
                    }}
                    title="Logout"
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div
                className="messenger-account-item add"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowAccounts(false);
                  setShowLogin(true);
                }}
              >
                <span className="messenger-account-avatar">+</span>
                <span style={{ color: "var(--accent)" }}>Add account</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="messenger-chat-list">
          {loadingChats && (
            <div className="messenger-empty">Loading chats…</div>
          )}
          {!loadingChats && chats.length === 0 && (
            <div className="messenger-empty">No chats</div>
          )}
          {chats.map((c) => (
            <div
              key={c.id}
              className={`messenger-chat-item ${
                c.id === activeChat ? "active" : ""
              }`}
              onClick={() => setActiveChat(c.id)}
            >
              <div className="messenger-chat-avatar">
                {c.type === "channel"
                  ? "📢"
                  : c.type === "group"
                  ? "👥"
                  : c.type === "bot"
                  ? "🤖"
                  : "👤"}
              </div>
              <div className="messenger-chat-info">
                <div className="messenger-chat-title">
                  {c.pinned && (
                    <span style={{ color: "var(--accent)", fontSize: 10 }}>
                      📌{" "}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {c.title}
                </div>
                <div className="messenger-chat-preview">
                  {c.lastMessagePreview || "—"}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="messenger-chat-meta">
                <div className="messenger-chat-time">
                  {formatTime(c.lastMessageAt)}
                </div>
                {c.unreadCount > 0 && (
                  <div className="messenger-chat-badge">{c.unreadCount}</div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Messages column */}
      <div className="messenger-view">
        {activeChatObj ? (
          <>
            <div className="messenger-view-header">
              <button
                className="menu-btn"
                style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
                onClick={() => setActiveChat(null)}
                title="Back"
              >
                ←
              </button>
              <div
                className="messenger-chat-avatar"
                style={{ marginRight: 10 }}
              >
                {activeChatObj.type === "channel"
                  ? "📢"
                  : activeChatObj.type === "group"
                  ? "👥"
                  : activeChatObj.type === "bot"
                  ? "🤖"
                  : "👤"}
              </div>
              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{activeChatObj.title}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "var(--text-dim)" }}>
                  {activeChatObj.type}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="messenger-messages">
              {loadingMessages && (
                <div className="messenger-empty">Loading messages…</div>
              )}
              {!loadingMessages && messages.length === 0 && (
                <div className="messenger-empty">No messages yet</div>
              )}
              {messages.map((m) => (
                <div
                  key={m.id}
                  className={`messenger-msg ${
                    m.outgoing ? "outgoing" : "incoming"
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="messenger-msg-text">{m.text}</div>
                  <div className="messenger-msg-time">
                    {formatTime(m.date)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="messenger-composer">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Message..."
                value={draft}
                onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    send();
                  }
                }}
              />
              <button onClick={send} disabled={!draft.trim()}>
                Send
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="messenger-empty-large">
            <div style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 12 }}>💬</div>
            <div>Select a chat</div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function formatTime(ts: number): string {
  if (!ts) return "";
  const d = new Date(ts);
  const now = new Date();
  const sameDay =
    d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() &&
    d.getMonth() === now.getMonth() &&
    d.getDate() === now.getDate();
  if (sameDay) {
    return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
  }
  return d.toLocaleDateString([], { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

@'
// Polyfills for GramJS (browser environment).

import { Buffer } from "buffer";
import process from "process";

const g = globalThis as unknown as {
  Buffer?: typeof Buffer;
  process?: typeof process;
  global?: typeof globalThis;
};

@'
// Telegram client — using teleproto (maintained fork of GramJS).
// Lazy-loaded so the main app doesn't pull in Node polyfills on startup.

export interface TgSessionInfo {
  id: string;
  phone: string;
  username?: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  userId?: string;
  authState: "authorized" | "needs_code" | "needs_password" | "offline";
}

interface StoredSession {
  id: string;
  sessionString: string;
  info: TgSessionInfo;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "raymond_tg_sessions_v1";

function loadStored(): StoredSession[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return JSON.parse(raw) as StoredSession[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveStored(list: StoredSession[]): void {
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
}

type TeleprotoModule = {
  TelegramClient: new (
    session: unknown,
    apiId: number,
    apiHash: string,
    opts: Record<string, unknown>
  ) => TeleprotoClient;
  StringSession: new (str: string) => { save: () => string };
  Api: Record<string, unknown>;
};

type TeleprotoClient = {
  connect: () => Promise<void>;
  sendCode: (opts: { apiId: number; apiHash: string }, phone: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  signIn: (opts: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>;
  getMe: () => Promise<{ id?: unknown; username?: string; firstName?: string; lastName?: string }>;
  logOut: () => Promise<void>;
  disconnect: () => Promise<void>;
  session: { save: () => string };
};

const API_ID = 2040;
const API_HASH = "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627";

let libPromise: Promise<TeleprotoModule> | null = null;

async function loadLib(): Promise<TeleprotoModule> {
  if (!libPromise) {
    await import("./polyfills");
    libPromise = (async () => {
      const mod = (await import("teleproto")) as unknown as {
        TelegramClient: TeleprotoModule["TelegramClient"];
        Api: TeleprotoModule["Api"];
      };
      const sessions = (await import("teleproto/sessions")) as unknown as {
        StringSession: TeleprotoModule["StringSession"];
      };
      return {
        TelegramClient: mod.TelegramClient,
        StringSession: sessions.StringSession,
        Api: mod.Api,
      };
    })();
  }
  return libPromise;
}

export class TgManager {
  private clients = new Map<string, TeleprotoClient>();
  private sessions: StoredSession[] = loadStored();
  private pending = new Map<string, { client: TeleprotoClient; phone: string }>();

  listAccounts(): TgSessionInfo[] {
    return this.sessions.map((s) => s.info);
  }

  async startLogin(phone: string): Promise<{ sessionId: string }> {
    const lib = await loadLib();
    const sessionId = "tg_" + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    const client = new lib.TelegramClient(new lib.StringSession(""), API_ID, API_HASH, {
      connectionRetries: 3,
      useWSS: true,
    });
    await client.connect();
    await client.sendCode({ apiId: API_ID, apiHash: API_HASH }, phone);
    this.pending.set(sessionId, { client, phone });
    return { sessionId };
  }

  async completeLogin(
    sessionId: string,
    code: string,
    password?: string
  ): Promise<TgSessionInfo> {
    const p = this.pending.get(sessionId);
    if (!p) throw new Error("Login session expired");

    try {
      await p.client.signIn({
        phoneNumber: p.phone,
        phoneCode: async () => code,
        password: async () => password ?? "",
        onError: (e: Error) => { throw e; },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const e = err as Error & { errorMessage?: string };
      if (e.errorMessage === "SESSION_PASSWORD_NEEDED" && !password) {
        const error = new Error("2FA password required");
        (error as Error & { needs2FA?: boolean }).needs2FA = true;
        throw error;
      }
      throw err;
    }

    const me = await p.client.getMe();
    const sessionString = p.client.session.save();

    const info: TgSessionInfo = {
      id: sessionId,
      phone: p.phone,
      username: me.username ?? undefined,
      firstName: me.firstName ?? undefined,
      lastName: me.lastName ?? undefined,
      userId: me.id?.toString(),
      authState: "authorized",
    };

    this.sessions.push({ id: sessionId, sessionString, info });
    saveStored(this.sessions);
    this.clients.set(sessionId, p.client);
    this.pending.delete(sessionId);

    return info;
  }

  async restoreAll(): Promise<TgSessionInfo[]> {
    const lib = await loadLib();
    const restored: TgSessionInfo[] = [];
    for (const s of this.sessions) {
      try {
        const client = new lib.TelegramClient(
          new lib.StringSession(s.sessionString),
          API_ID,
          API_HASH,
          { connectionRetries: 3, useWSS: true }
        );
        await client.connect();
        this.clients.set(s.id, client);
        restored.push(s.info);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to restore", s.id, err);
      }
    }
    return restored;
  }

  async logout(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const client = this.clients.get(sessionId);
    if (client) {
      try { await client.logOut(); } catch {}
      try { await client.disconnect(); } catch {}
    }
    this.clients.delete(sessionId);
    this.sessions = this.sessions.filter((s) => s.id !== sessionId);
    saveStored(this.sessions);
  }
}

export const tgManager = new TgManager();

// Telegram client — using mtcute/web (built for browsers).
// Lazy-loaded so the main app loads fast.

export interface TgSessionInfo {
  id: string;
  phone: string;
  username?: string;
  firstName?: string;
  lastName?: string;
  userId?: string;
  authState: "authorized" | "needs_code" | "needs_password" | "offline";
}

interface StoredSession {
  id: string;
  phone: string;
  info: TgSessionInfo;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "raymond_tg_accounts_v1";

function loadStored(): StoredSession[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return JSON.parse(raw) as StoredSession[];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveStored(list: StoredSession[]): void {
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
}

type MtcuteClient = {
  start: (opts: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<{ id?: unknown; username?: string; displayName?: string }>;
  sendText: (peer: string, text: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  getMe: () => Promise<{ id?: unknown; username?: string; displayName?: string }>;
  call: (req: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>;
  getChats?: (opts?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown[]>;
  getHistory?: (peer: string, opts?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown[]>;
  destroy: () => Promise<void>;
};

type MtcuteModule = {
  TelegramClient: new (opts: Record<string, unknown>) => MtcuteClient;
};

const API_ID = 2040;
const API_HASH = "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627";

let libPromise: Promise<MtcuteModule> | null = null;

async function loadLib(): Promise<MtcuteModule> {
  if (!libPromise) {
    libPromise = (async () => {
      const mod = (await import("@mtcute/web")) as unknown as MtcuteModule;
      return mod;
    })();
  }
  return libPromise;
}

export class TgManager {
  private clients = new Map<string, MtcuteClient>();
  private sessions: StoredSession[] = loadStored();
  private pending = new Map<string, { client: MtcuteClient; phone: string }>();

  listAccounts(): TgSessionInfo[] {
    return this.sessions.map((s) => s.info);
  }

  async startLogin(phone: string): Promise<{ sessionId: string }> {
    const lib = await loadLib();
    const sessionId = "tg_" + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

    const client = new lib.TelegramClient({
      apiId: API_ID,
      apiHash: API_HASH,
      storage: `raymond-${sessionId}`,
    });

    this.pending.set(sessionId, { client, phone });
    return { sessionId };
  }

  async completeLogin(
    sessionId: string,
    code: string,
    password?: string
  ): Promise<TgSessionInfo> {
    const p = this.pending.get(sessionId);
    if (!p) throw new Error("Login session expired");

    try {
      const user = await p.client.start({
        phone: p.phone,
        code: () => code,
        password: () => password ?? "",
      });

      const info: TgSessionInfo = {
        id: sessionId,
        phone: p.phone,
        username: user.username ?? undefined,
        firstName: user.displayName ?? undefined,
        userId: user.id?.toString(),
        authState: "authorized",
      };

      this.sessions.push({ id: sessionId, phone: p.phone, info });
      saveStored(this.sessions);
      this.clients.set(sessionId, p.client);
      this.pending.delete(sessionId);

      return info;
    } catch (err) {
      const e = err as Error & { needs2FA?: boolean };
      if (e.message?.includes("2FA") || e.message?.includes("password")) {
        const error = new Error("2FA password required");
        (error as Error & { needs2FA?: boolean }).needs2FA = true;
        throw error;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async restoreAll(): Promise<TgSessionInfo[]> {
    const lib = await loadLib();
    const restored: TgSessionInfo[] = [];
    for (const s of this.sessions) {
      try {
        const client = new lib.TelegramClient({
          apiId: API_ID,
          apiHash: API_HASH,
          storage: `raymond-${s.id}`,
        });
        this.clients.set(s.id, client);
        restored.push(s.info);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to restore", s.id, err);
      }
    }
    return restored;
  }

  async logout(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
    const client = this.clients.get(sessionId);
    if (client) {
      try { await client.destroy(); } catch {}
    }
    this.clients.delete(sessionId);
    this.sessions = this.sessions.filter((s) => s.id !== sessionId);
    saveStored(this.sessions);
  }
}

اگه بازم ERROR داد
راه‌حل قطعی: از API_ID عمومی معتبر دیگه‌ای استفاده کنیم که برای کلاینت‌های شخصی تست شده.

مثلاً:

text
API_ID = 2496
API_HASH = "8da85b0d5bfe62527e5b244c209159c3"
(این مربوط به یه کلاینت متن‌باز معروفه)

اول راه‌حل‌های ۱ و ۲ رو امتحان کن. اگه جواب داد، بگو تا API credentials جدید رو جایگزین کنیم. اگه باز ERROR داد، بگو تا از API_ID جایگزین استفاده کنیم و کد رو تست کنیم.

برو همون عمومی 
باشه، برمی‌گردیم به API عمومی. ولی این بار یه API_ID دیگه که برای کلاینت‌های متن‌باز تست‌شده.

این اسکریپت رو بزن:
powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$c = Get-Content "src\ui\lib\telegram\client.ts" -Raw

# Replace with a different public API_ID (used by open-source clients)
$c = $c -replace 'const API_ID = \d+;', 'const API_ID = 2496;'
$c = $c -replace 'const API_HASH = "[^"]+";', 'const API_HASH = "8da85b0d5bfe62527e5b244c209159c3";'

$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path "src\ui\lib\telegram\client.ts"), $c, $utf8NoBom)

Write-Host "API credentials changed to 2496" -ForegroundColor Green

# Show what's now in the file
Select-String -Path "src\ui\lib\telegram\client.ts" -Pattern "API_ID|API_HASH"

راه‌حل عملی که می‌تونیم الان بسازیم
قبل از VPS، این رو بسازیم:

فاز ۱ (الان، رایگان):
Capability network-proxy با پشتیبانی از HTTP/SOCKS5 Proxy

توی Settings یه فرم می‌ذاریم: آدرس پروکسی، پورت، یوزرنیم/پسورد

هر درخواست خروجی ریموند (MTProto، AI APIs، X API، ...) از این پروکسی رد می‌شه

پشتیبانی از HTTP proxy و SOCKS5 proxy

این روی Cloudflare کار می‌کنه چون Cloudflare Workers پشتیبانی می‌کنه از اتصال به SOCKS/HTTP proxy (باید تست کنیم).

فرق با V2Ray:

V2Ray پروتکلش VMess/VLESS هست که SOCKS5 نیست

ولی V2Ray خودش یه SOCKS5 inbound می‌ده روی یه پورت لوکال

شما می‌تونی V2Ray رو توی خونه یا VPS اجرا کنی، یه SOCKS5 پورت ازش بگیری (127.0.0.1:1080)، و بعد از طریق یه تونل (مثل Cloudflare Tunnel یا ngrok یا Tailscale) در اختیار ریموند بذاری

پیچیده‌ست ولی ممکنه.

فاز ۲ (با VPS):
Capability network-proxy با پشتیبانی از V2Ray

VPS agent که V2Ray رو مدیریت می‌کنه

ریموند به VPS وصل می‌شه با یه shared secret

VPS ترافیک رو از V2Ray رد می‌کنه

همه چیز شفاف برای ریموند

فاز ۳ (پلاگین فروش):
Capability vpn-service (جدا)

پنل کاربر

صدور کانفیگ

آمار

این جداست، به Core دست نمی‌زنه

VMess؟ VLESS؟

با TLS؟ Reality؟

از یه provider اشتراکی می‌گیری؟ یا خودت سرور داری؟

۲. V2Ray رو کجا اجرا می‌کنی؟

روی لپ‌تاپ خودت؟

روی موبایل؟

روی یه VPS؟

سه لایه تشخیص
لایه ۱: Rule-based (سریع، رایگان)

کلمات کلیدی: اگه پیام شامل code, bug, function, کد, برنامه بود → coder

اگه شامل translate, ترجمه بود → translation model

اگه شامل analyze, تحلیل, why بود → reasoning model

لایه ۲: Heuristic (بر اساس طول و ساختار)

پیام کوتاه (< ۲۰ کلمه) → مدل سریع

پیام بلند (> ۵۰۰ کلمه) → مدل با context بزرگ

پیام با کد (```) → coder

لایه ۳: AI-based classifier (فقط وقتی قطعی نیست)

یه درخواست سریع به یه مدل کوچیک (مثل Gemma 3 4B)

دسته رو تشخیص می‌ده

فقط ۱۰٪ مواقع لازم می‌شه

         Hetzner (نصب می‌کنیم، آماده می‌شه)

بعد از دو هفته:
  User → Hetzner (ریموند کامل)
                ↓ backup
         Cloudflare (خاموش، فقط backup)
اینطوری:

✅ چیزی از دست نمی‌ره

✅ می‌تونی هر دو رو داشته باشی

✅ اگه Hetzner خراب شد، Cloudflare هست

✅ وقتی مطمئن شدی، Cloudflare رو خاموش می‌کنی

چی روی Hetzner نصب می‌کنیم (مرحله به مرحله)
مرحله ۱ (امشب): SSH Key + امنیت + Docker
مرحله ۲: Node.js + PostgreSQL + Redis
مرحله ۳: Xray (V2Ray) — پروکسی
مرحله ۴: Raymond Node Agent — ریموند رو روش نصب کنیم
مرحله ۵: TDLib — MTProto Telegram
مرحله ۶: Ollama — AI لوکال (با ۴GB RAM، فقط مدل‌های کوچیک)
مرحله ۷: Caddy/Nginx + SSL
مرحله ۸: اتصال به Cloudflare (Tunnel)
مرحله ۹: Migration کامل (بعد از دو هفته)

درباره GitHub
GitHub لازمه. نمی‌شه ریموند رو بدون version control نگه داری. دلیل:

اگه Hetzner خراب شه، کدت از دست می‌ره

نمی‌تونی بفهمی کدوم تغییر خوب بود کدوم بد

rollback ممکن نیست

deploy خودکار ممکن نیست

ولی می‌تونی به جای GitHub از GitLab self-hosted روی همون Hetzner استفاده کنی. یا از Gitea.

پیشنهاد: فعلاً GitHub رو نگه دار. بعداً اگه خواستی به Gitea مهاجرت می‌کنیم.

درباره Cloudflare
Cloudflare در معماری ما Contract داره. یعنی:

Storage (D1) → فردا PostgreSQL روی Hetzner

Secrets → فردا Vault روی Hetzner

Workers → فردا Node.js روی Hetzner

AI (Workers AI) → فردا Ollama روی Hetzner

پس انتقال یه روزه با کلید Contract انجام می‌شه. فقط باید:

روی Hetzner همون Contracts پیاده‌سازی شه با adapter جدید

UI رو از Cloudflare بگیریم، روی Hetzner بذاریم

دیتا رو منتقل کنیم

این دقیقاً چیزیه که معماری Contract برای همین لحظه ساخت.

پیشنهاد نهایی
امشب: Hetzner رو امن و آماده می‌کنیم (۱ ساعت)
فردا شب: Node.js + DB + Xray نصب می‌کنیم (۱ ساعت)
پس‌فردا: Raymond Node Agent رو می‌نویسیم (۲ ساعت)
بعدش: MTProto Telegram (۲ ساعت)
بعدش: Local AI (۱ ساعت)
آخر: مهاجرت از Cloudflare (۱ ساعت)

کل: ۱ هفته کار (۲-۳ ساعت در روز)

بعد از این، Hetzner سرور اصلی می‌شه. Cloudflare فقط یه backup می‌مونه (یا خاموشش می‌کنیم).

سوال از تو
موافقی با این ترتیب؟

۱. الان: امن‌سازی Hetzner
۲. بعداً: نصب سرویس‌ها
۳. نهایتاً: مهاجرت کامل

یا می‌خوای مستقیم بریم سراغ یه چیز خاص؟

مثلاً بگو «می‌خوام همین امشب Xray کار کنه» تا اول اون رو راه بندازیم.

بگو چی می‌خوای تا شروع کنیم.

اوکی پس گیت و کلود فلر باشه 
الان وصل شدم چبکار کنم
بریم مرحله به مرحله. الان امنیت سرور رو راه می‌ندازیم (۱ ساعت)، بعد می‌ریم سراغ سرویس‌ها.

هر دو رو کپی کن و یه جا نگه دار (Private مهمه، Public رو بعداً به کلاینت می‌دی).

فایل رو با این محتوا جایگزین کن (مقادیر رو با اونایی که ساختی عوض کن):

json

    "loglevel": "warning"
  },

          }
        ],
        "decryption": "none"
      },
      "streamSettings": {
        "network": "tcp",
        "security": "reality",
        "realitySettings": {
          "dest": "www.cloudflare.com:443",
          "serverNames": ["www.cloudflare.com"],
          "privateKey": "PRIVATE_KEY_خودت_اینجا",
          "shortIds": ["SHORT_ID_خودت_اینجا"]
        }
      },
      "sniffing": {
        "enabled": true,
        "destOverride": ["http", "tls", "quic"]
      }
    }
  ],
  "outbounds": [
    {
      "protocol": "freedom",
      "tag": "direct"
    },
    {
      "protocol": "blackhole",
      "tag": "blocked"
    }
  ],
  "routing": {
    "rules": [
      {
        "type": "field",
        "protocol": ["bittorrent"],
        "outboundTag": "blocked"
      }
    ]
  }
}
مقادیر رو عوض کن:

UUID_خودت_اینجا → UUID که با xray uuid ساختی

PRIVATE_KEY_خودت_اینجا → private key که با xray x25519 ساختی

SHORT_ID_خودت_اینجا → short ID که با openssl rand -hex 8 ساختی

ذخیره: Ctrl+O → Enter → Ctrl+X

⚠️ نکته امنیتی مهم
توی این پیام که فرستادی، private key رو هم گذاشتی:

text
PrivateKey: -H35XkS303Gn_Yhk2dQJTXIBbD2s7q-K-MXy46SkaVE
این خیلی خطرناکه اگه بفهمه کسی، می‌تونه سرورت رو به عنوان یه سرور دیگه impersonate کنه.

ولی ما همین الان با همین private key کانفیگ رو ساختیم. پس دو تا راه داری:

راه A (ساده): همون private key رو نگه دار، ولی دیگه جایی نفرستش. حالا که توی چت اومده، ریسک کوچیکی داره ولی چون تازه ساختیم و IP و پورت رو کسی نمی‌دونه، مشکلی نیست.

راه B (امن‌تر): private key جدید بساز:

bash
xray x25519
کلید جدید رو کپی کن، PublicKey جدید رو برام بفرست (PrivateKey رو نفرست)، بعد کانفیگ سرور رو با private key جدید آپدیت کن.

پیشنهاد: راه A رو انتخاب کن ولی از این به بعد private key رو نفرست.

        ↓ WebSocket + Shared Secret

اجرا می‌کنه و نتیجه رو برمی‌گردونه

آمار سرور (CPU، RAM، ترافیک) رو می‌فرسته

مرحله ۳: کد اصلی Node Agent
src/index.ts:
bash
nano src/index.ts
محتوا:

typescript
// Raymond Node Agent
// Connects to Raymond's Worker over WebSocket and executes tasks.

import WebSocket from "ws";
import os from "node:os";
import { exec } from "node:child_process";
import { promisify } from "node:util";

const execAsync = promisify(exec);

const WS_URL = process.env.RAYMOND_WS_URL!;
const NODE_SECRET = process.env.NODE_SECRET!;
const NODE_ID = process.env.NODE_ID ?? "node-01";

if (!WS_URL || !NODE_SECRET) {
  console.error("Missing RAYMOND_WS_URL or NODE_SECRET");
  process.exit(1);
}

interface TaskRequest {
  type: "task";
  id: string;
  task: string;
  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface TaskResponse {
  type: "task_result";
  id: string;
  ok: boolean;
  output?: unknown;
  error?: string;
}

let ws: WebSocket | null = null;
let reconnectDelay = 1000;
const MAX_RECONNECT = 30000;

function connect(): void {
  console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Connecting to ${WS_URL}...`);

  ws = new WebSocket(WS_URL, {
    headers: {
      "X-Raymond-Node-Id": NODE_ID,
      "X-Raymond-Node-Secret": NODE_SECRET,
    },
  });

  ws.on("open", () => {
    console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Connected`);
    reconnectDelay = 1000;
    send({
      type: "hello",
      nodeId: NODE_ID,
      hostname: os.hostname(),
      platform: os.platform(),
      arch: os.arch(),
      cpuCount: os.cpus().length,
      memoryMb: Math.floor(os.totalmem() / 1024 / 1024),
      uptime: os.uptime(),
    });
    startHeartbeat();
  });

  ws.on("message", async (data) => {
    try {
      const msg = JSON.parse(data.toString());
      if (msg.type === "task") {
        await handleTask(msg as TaskRequest);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Bad message:", err);
    }
  });

  ws.on("close", () => {
    console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Disconnected. Reconnecting in ${reconnectDelay}ms`);
    setTimeout(connect, reconnectDelay);
    reconnectDelay = Math.min(reconnectDelay * 2, MAX_RECONNECT);
  });

  ws.on("error", (err) => {
    console.error(`[${NODE_ID}] WS error:`, err.message);
  });
}

function send(obj: unknown): void {
  if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
    ws.send(JSON.stringify(obj));
  }
}

let heartbeatInterval: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

function startHeartbeat(): void {
  if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
  heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
    send({
      type: "heartbeat",
      nodeId: NODE_ID,
      uptime: os.uptime(),
      loadAvg: os.loadavg(),
      freeMemMb: Math.floor(os.freemem() / 1024 / 1024),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    });
  }, 30000);
}

async function handleTask(req: TaskRequest): Promise<void> {
  console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Task: ${req.task}`);
  const started = Date.now();

  try {
    let output: unknown;
    switch (req.task) {
      case "system.info":
        output = systemInfo();
        break;
      case "shell.exec":
        output = await shellExec(
          (req.payload?.cmd as string) ?? "",
          (req.payload?.timeout as number) ?? 30000
        );
        break;
      case "docker.ps":
        output = await shellExec("docker ps --format json");
        break;
      case "xray.status":
        output = await shellExec("systemctl is-active xray");
        break;
      case "xray.restart":
        output = await shellExec("sudo systemctl restart xray");
        break;
      case "ping":
        output = { pong: true, at: Date.now() };
        break;
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown task: ${req.task}`);
    }

    send({
      type: "task_result",
      id: req.id,
      ok: true,
      output,
    } as TaskResponse);
    console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Task ${req.task} done in ${Date.now() - started}ms`);
  } catch (err) {
    send({
      type: "task_result",
      id: req.id,
      ok: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
    } as TaskResponse);
    console.error(`[${NODE_ID}] Task failed:`, err);
  }
}

function systemInfo(): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    hostname: os.hostname(),
    platform: os.platform(),
    arch: os.arch(),
    release: os.release(),
    cpuModel: os.cpus()[0]?.model,
    cpuCount: os.cpus().length,
    loadAvg: os.loadavg(),
    totalMemMb: Math.floor(os.totalmem() / 1024 / 1024),
    freeMemMb: Math.floor(os.freemem() / 1024 / 1024),
    uptime: os.uptime(),
    nodeVersion: process.version,
  };
}

async function shellExec(
  cmd: string,
  timeoutMs = 30000
): Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string }> {
  if (!cmd || cmd.length > 2000) throw new Error("Invalid command");
  const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(cmd, {
    timeout: timeoutMs,
    maxBuffer: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
  });
  return { stdout: stdout.trim(), stderr: stderr.trim() };
}

connect();

process.on("SIGTERM", () => {
  console.log("Shutting down...");
  ws?.close();
  process.exit(0);
});

import WebSocket from "ws";
import os from "node:os";
import { exec } from "node:child_process";
import { promisify } from "node:util";

const execAsync = promisify(exec);

const WS_URL = process.env.RAYMOND_WS_URL!;
const NODE_SECRET = process.env.NODE_SECRET!;
const NODE_ID = process.env.NODE_ID ?? "node-01";

if (!WS_URL || !NODE_SECRET) {
  console.error("Missing RAYMOND_WS_URL or NODE_SECRET");
  process.exit(1);
}

interface TaskRequest {
  type: "task";
  id: string;
  task: string;
  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface TaskResponse {
  type: "task_result";
  id: string;
  ok: boolean;
  output?: unknown;
  error?: string;
}

let ws: WebSocket | null = null;
let reconnectDelay = 1000;
const MAX_RECONNECT = 30000;

function connect(): void {
  console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Connecting to ${WS_URL}...`);

  ws = new WebSocket(WS_URL, {
    headers: {
      "X-Raymond-Node-Id": NODE_ID,
      "X-Raymond-Node-Secret": NODE_SECRET,
    },
  });

  ws.on("open", () => {
    console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Connected`);
    reconnectDelay = 1000;
    send({
      type: "hello",
      nodeId: NODE_ID,
      hostname: os.hostname(),
      platform: os.platform(),
      arch: os.arch(),
      cpuCount: os.cpus().length,
      memoryMb: Math.floor(os.totalmem() / 1024 / 1024),
      uptime: os.uptime(),
    });
    startHeartbeat();
  });

  ws.on("message", async (data) => {
    try {
      const msg = JSON.parse(data.toString());
      if (msg.type === "task") {
        await handleTask(msg as TaskRequest);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Bad message:", err);
    }
  });

  ws.on("close", () => {
    console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Disconnected. Reconnecting in ${reconnectDelay}ms`);
    setTimeout(connect, reconnectDelay);
    reconnectDelay = Math.min(reconnectDelay * 2, MAX_RECONNECT);
  });

  ws.on("error", (err) => {
    console.error(`[${NODE_ID}] WS error:`, err.message);
  });
}

function send(obj: unknown): void {
  if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
    ws.send(JSON.stringify(obj));
  }
}

let heartbeatInterval: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

function startHeartbeat(): void {
  if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
  heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
    send({
      type: "heartbeat",
      nodeId: NODE_ID,
      uptime: os.uptime(),
      loadAvg: os.loadavg(),
      freeMemMb: Math.floor(os.freemem() / 1024 / 1024),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    });
  }, 30000);
}

async function handleTask(req: TaskRequest): Promise<void> {
  console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Task: ${req.task}`);
  const started = Date.now();

  try {
    let output: unknown;
    switch (req.task) {
      case "system.info":
        output = systemInfo();
        break;
      case "shell.exec":
        output = await shellExec(
          (req.payload?.cmd as string) ?? "",
          (req.payload?.timeout as number) ?? 30000
        );
        break;
      case "docker.ps":
        output = await shellExec("docker ps --format json");
        break;
      case "xray.status":
        output = await shellExec("systemctl is-active xray");
        break;
      case "xray.restart":
        output = await shellExec("sudo systemctl restart xray");
        break;
      case "ping":
        output = { pong: true, at: Date.now() };
        break;
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown task: ${req.task}`);
    }

    send({
      type: "task_result",
      id: req.id,
      ok: true,
      output,
    } as TaskResponse);
    console.log(`[${NODE_ID}] Task ${req.task} done in ${Date.now() - started}ms`);
  } catch (err) {
    send({
      type: "task_result",
      id: req.id,
      ok: false,
      error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
    } as TaskResponse);
    console.error(`[${NODE_ID}] Task failed:`, err);
  }
}

function systemInfo(): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    hostname: os.hostname(),
    platform: os.platform(),
    arch: os.arch(),
    release: os.release(),
    cpuModel: os.cpus()[0]?.model,
    cpuCount: os.cpus().length,
    loadAvg: os.loadavg(),
    totalMemMb: Math.floor(os.totalmem() / 1024 / 1024),
    freeMemMb: Math.floor(os.freemem() / 1024 / 1024),
    uptime: os.uptime(),
    nodeVersion: process.version,
  };
}

async function shellExec(
  cmd: string,
  timeoutMs = 30000
): Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string }> {
  if (!cmd || cmd.length > 2000) throw new Error("Invalid command");
  const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(cmd, {
    timeout: timeoutMs,
    maxBuffer: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
  });
  return { stdout: stdout.trim(), stderr: stderr.trim() };
}

connect();

process.on("SIGTERM", () => {
  console.log("Shutting down...");
  ws?.close();
  process.exit(0);
});
ENDOFFILE

@'
// Node Agent Durable Object
// Bridges Cloudflare and a remote Raymond Node (e.g. the VPS).

import { verifyNodeSecret } from "../core/node-auth";

interface HelloMessage {
  type: "hello";
  nodeId: string;
  hostname?: string;
  platform?: string;
  arch?: string;
  cpuCount?: number;
  memoryMb?: number;
  uptime?: number;
}

interface HeartbeatMessage {
  type: "heartbeat";
  nodeId: string;
  uptime?: number;
  loadAvg?: number[];
  freeMemMb?: number;
  timestamp?: number;
}

interface TaskResultMessage {
  type: "task_result";
  id: string;
  ok: boolean;
  output?: unknown;
  error?: string;
}

interface NodeState {
  nodeId: string;
  info: HelloMessage;
  lastHeartbeat: number;
  connectedAt: number;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = "node-state";

export class NodeAgent {
  private node: NodeState | null = null;
  private ws: WebSocket | null = null;
  private pending = new Map<string, (msg: TaskResultMessage) => void>();

  constructor(
    private state: DurableObjectState,
    private env: { NODE_SECRET?: string }
  ) {}

  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    const upgrade = request.headers.get("Upgrade");

    // WebSocket from the node agent
    if (upgrade === "websocket") {
      // Authenticate
      const secret = request.headers.get("X-Raymond-Node-Secret") ?? "";
      const nodeId = request.headers.get("X-Raymond-Node-Id") ?? "";
      if (!verifyNodeSecret(this.env.NODE_SECRET ?? "", secret)) {
        return new Response("Unauthorized", { status: 401 });
      }

      const pair = new WebSocketPair();
      const client = pair[0];
      const server = pair[1];
      server.accept();
      this.attachNode(nodeId, server);
      return new Response(null, { status: 101, webSocket: client });
    }

    // HTTP: status / task submission
    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/status")) {
      const stored = await this.state.storage.get<NodeState>(STORAGE_KEY);
      return Response.json({
        connected: this.ws !== null,
        node: stored ?? this.node,
      });
    }

    if (url.pathname.endsWith("/task") && request.method === "POST") {
      const body = (await request.json()) as {
        task: string;
        payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
        timeoutMs?: number;
      };
      try {
        const result = await this.runTask(body.task, body.payload, body.timeoutMs);
        return Response.json(result);
      } catch (err) {
        return Response.json(
          { ok: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) },
          { status: 500 }
        );
      }
    }

    return new Response("Not found", { status: 404 });
  }

  private attachNode(nodeId: string, ws: WebSocket): void {
    // Close any existing connection
    if (this.ws && this.ws !== ws) {
      try { this.ws.close(1000, "replaced"); } catch {}
    }
    this.ws = ws;
    const now = Date.now();
    this.node = {
      nodeId,
      info: { type: "hello", nodeId },
      lastHeartbeat: now,
      connectedAt: now,
    };

    ws.addEventListener("message", (evt) => {
      try {
        const data = evt.data as string;
        const msg = JSON.parse(data);

        if (msg.type === "hello") {
          this.node = {
            nodeId: msg.nodeId ?? nodeId,
            info: msg as HelloMessage,
            lastHeartbeat: Date.now(),
            connectedAt: this.node?.connectedAt ?? Date.now(),
          };
          void this.state.storage.put(STORAGE_KEY, this.node);
        } else if (msg.type === "heartbeat") {
          if (this.node) {
            this.node.lastHeartbeat = Date.now();
            this.node.info.uptime = (msg as HeartbeatMessage).uptime;
          }
        } else if (msg.type === "task_result") {
          const result = msg as TaskResultMessage;
          const resolver = this.pending.get(result.id);
          if (resolver) {
            resolver(result);
            this.pending.delete(result.id);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Bad message from node:", err);
      }
    });

    ws.addEventListener("close", () => {
      if (this.ws === ws) {
        this.ws = null;
        this.node = null;
      }
    });

    ws.addEventListener("error", (evt) => {
      console.error("Node WS error:", evt);
    });

    // Initialize storage
    void this.state.storage.put(STORAGE_KEY, this.node);
  }

  async runTask(
    task: string,
    payload?: Record<string, unknown>,
    timeoutMs = 30000
  ): Promise<TaskResultMessage> {
    if (!this.ws || this.ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
      throw new Error("Node not connected");
    }

    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    return await new Promise<TaskResultMessage>((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pending.delete(id);
        reject(new Error(`Task timed out: ${task}`));
      }, timeoutMs);

      this.pending.set(id, (msg) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(msg);
      });

      this.ws!.send(JSON.stringify({ type: "task", id, task, payload }));
    });
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\do\node-agent.ts" -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "  node-agent.ts created" -ForegroundColor Green
فایل src\worker\core\node-auth.ts:

@'
// Constant-time comparison of node secrets.
// Both strings must be hex or any string of equal length.

export function verifyNodeSecret(expected: string, provided: string): boolean {
  if (!expected || !provided) return false;
  const a = new TextEncoder().encode(expected);
  const b = new TextEncoder().encode(provided);
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) diff |= a[i] ^ b[i];
  return diff === 0;
}

// Node Agent routes — WebSocket + task API.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Env } from "../core/db";

export const nodeRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

// WebSocket + status + task
nodeRoutes.all("/ws", async (c) => {
  const nodeId = c.req.query("nodeId") ?? "default";
  const id = c.env.NODE_AGENT.idFromName(nodeId);
  const stub = c.env.NODE_AGENT.get(id);

// D1 database helper

export interface Env {
  DB: D1Database;
  AI: Ai;
  ASSETS: Fetcher;
  TELEGRAM_PROXY: DurableObjectNamespace;
  NODE_AGENT: DurableObjectNamespace;
  ENVIRONMENT: string;
  APP_NAME: string;
  OPENROUTER_API_KEY?: string;
  OLLAMA_URL?: string;
  RAYMOND_MASTER_KEY?: string;
  NODE_SECRET?: string;
}

export async function queryFirst<T = unknown>(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<T | null> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  return (await stmt.first<T>()) ?? null;
}

export async function queryAll<T = unknown>(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<T[]> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  const result = await stmt.all<T>();
  return (result.results ?? []) as T[];
}

export async function run(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<D1Result> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  return await stmt.run();
}

powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

@'
// Raymond Worker entry point.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import { cors } from "hono/cors";
import type { Env } from "./core/db";
import { registry } from "./core/registry";
import { aiChatCapability, setEnv } from "./capabilities/ai-chat";
import { chatRoutes } from "./routes/chat";
import { systemRoutes } from "./routes/system";
import { authRoutes } from "./routes/auth";
import { telegramRoutes } from "./routes/telegram";
import { telegramWsRoutes } from "./routes/telegram-ws";
import { nodeRoutes } from "./routes/node";
import { initRuntime } from "./runtime";
import { requireAuth } from "./middleware/require-auth";

// Durable Objects
export { TelegramProxy } from "./do/telegram-proxy";
export { NodeAgent } from "./do/node-agent";

type Bindings = Env;
const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Bindings }>();

// CORS
app.use(
  "*",
  cors({
    origin: (origin) => origin,
    credentials: true,
  })
);

// No-cache for HTML/JS/CSS
app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
  await next();
  const path = new URL(c.req.url).pathname;
  if (
    path === "/" ||
    path.endsWith(".html") ||
    path.endsWith(".js") ||
    path.endsWith(".css")
  ) {
    c.res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate");
  }
});

// Init runtime
app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
  initRuntime(c.env);
  setEnv(c.env);
  await next();
});

// ===== Public WebSocket routes (own auth) =====
app.route("/tg", telegramWsRoutes);
app.route("/node", nodeRoutes);

// ===== Auth API =====
app.route("/api/auth", authRoutes);

// ===== Everything under /api/* requires auth =====
app.use("/api/*", requireAuth());

app.route("/api/chat", chatRoutes);
app.route("/api/system", systemRoutes);
app.route("/api/telegram", telegramRoutes);

app.get("/api", (c) =>
  c.json({ app: c.env.APP_NAME ?? "Raymond", version: "0.4.0" })
);

app.all("/api/*", (c) => c.json({ error: "Not found" }, 404));

let bootstrapped = false;
async function bootstrap(env: Env): Promise<void> {
  if (bootstrapped) return;
  bootstrapped = true;
  registry.register(aiChatCapability.manifest);
  aiChatCapability.register();
  try {
    await registry.syncToDb(env);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Registry sync failed:", err);
  }
}

// Static assets (SPA)
app.all("*", async (c) => c.env.ASSETS.fetch(c.req.raw));

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<Response> {
    await bootstrap(env);
    initRuntime(env);
    setEnv(env);
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
} satisfies ExportedHandler<Env>;

powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

@'
// Node Agent routes — WebSocket + task API.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Env } from "../core/db";

export const nodeRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

// WebSocket from the node
nodeRoutes.get("/ws", async (c) => {
  const upgrade = c.req.header("Upgrade");
  if (upgrade !== "websocket") {
    return c.text("Expected WebSocket upgrade", 426);
  }

  const nodeId = c.req.header("X-Raymond-Node-Id") ?? "default";
  const id = c.env.NODE_AGENT.idFromName(nodeId);
  const stub = c.env.NODE_AGENT.get(id);
  return stub.fetch(c.req.raw);
});

// HTTP status
nodeRoutes.get("/:nodeId/status", async (c) => {
  const nodeId = c.req.param("nodeId");
  const id = c.env.NODE_AGENT.idFromName(nodeId);
  const stub = c.env.NODE_AGENT.get(id);
  const url = new URL(c.req.url);
  url.pathname = "/status";
  return stub.fetch(new Request(url.toString(), c.req.raw));
});

// HTTP task execution
nodeRoutes.post("/:nodeId/task", async (c) => {
  const nodeId = c.req.param("nodeId");
  const id = c.env.NODE_AGENT.idFromName(nodeId);
  const stub = c.env.NODE_AGENT.get(id);
  const url = new URL(c.req.url);
  url.pathname = "/task";
  return stub.fetch(
    new Request(url.toString(), {
      method: "POST",
      headers: c.req.raw.headers,
      body: await c.req.raw.text(),
    })
  );
});

sudo cat با redirection کار نمی‌کنه چون > توی shell اتفاق می‌افته، نه sudo. راه‌حل: اول فایل رو توی /tmp بساز، بعد با sudo ببرش.

bash

[Unit]
Description=Raymond Node Agent
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=raymond
WorkingDirectory=/home/raymond/raymond-node
EnvironmentFile=/home/raymond/raymond-node/.env
ExecStart=/usr/bin/npm start
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
(این بدون sudo کار می‌کنه چون /tmp اجازه نوشتن برای همه داره)

بریم سراغ Local AI (Ollama)
چون:

خواستی وقتی نت قطع شد، AI لوکال کار کنه

سرورت ۴GB RAM داره (کافیه برای مدل‌های ۳B یا ۷B quantized)

بدون Ollama، fallback نداری

مرحله ۱: نصب Ollama روی VPS
توی SSH سرور:

bash

bash

bash

این حدود ۲GB دانلود می‌کنه (چند دقیقه طول می‌کشه).

مرحله ۳: تست
bash

bash

مرحله ۵: باز کردن پورت توی فایروال
bash

⚠️ ولی این پورت رو نباید مستقیم روی اینترنت باز کنی. چون هرکسی می‌تونه از AI تو استفاده کنه.

راه امن: فقط از طریق Node Agent. فعلاً این کار رو می‌کنیم:

bash
sudo ufw delete allow 11434/tcp
یعنی هیچ‌وقت بازش نمی‌کنیم به بیرون. از طریق Node Agent (WebSocket امن) بهش دسترسی داریم.

مرحله ۶: تست از راه دور با Node Agent

typescript
      case "ollama.list":
        output = await shellExec("ollama list");
        break;
      case "ollama.run":
        output = await shellExec(
          `ollama run ${(req.payload?.model as string) ?? "qwen2.5:3b"} ${JSON.stringify((req.payload?.prompt as string) ?? "")}`,
          60000
        );
        break;

typescript
      case "ollama.list":
        output = await shellExec("curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/tags");
        break;
      case "ollama.chat": {
        const model = (req.payload?.model as string) ?? "qwen2.5:3b";
        const prompt = (req.payload?.prompt as string) ?? "";
        const body = JSON.stringify({
          model,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
          stream: false,
        });
        output = await shellExec(
          `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '${body.replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}'`,
          120000
        );
        break;
      }
