مرحله ۲: پیدا کردن نقطه درست
توی nano، Ctrl+W بزن (سرچ). تایپ کن:

text
default:
Enter بزن.

نشانگر می‌ره به خطی که default: هست. معمولاً این شکلیه:

typescript
      case "ping":
        output = { pong: true, at: Date.now() };
        break;
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown task: ${req.task}`);
    }
مرحله ۳: اضافه کردن کد قبل از default:
قبل از خط default: این کد رو paste کن:

typescript
      case "ollama.list":
        output = await shellExec("curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/tags");
        break;
      case "ollama.chat": {
        const model = (req.payload?.model as string) ?? "qwen2.5:3b";
        const prompt = (req.payload?.prompt as string) ?? "";
        const body = JSON.stringify({
          model,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
          stream: false,
        });
        output = await shellExec(
          `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '${body.replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}'`,
          120000
        );
        break;
      }
باید فایل اینطوری بشه:

typescript
      case "ping":
        output = { pong: true, at: Date.now() };
        break;
      case "ollama.list":
        output = await shellExec("curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/tags");
        break;
      case "ollama.chat": {
        const model = (req.payload?.model as string) ?? "qwen2.5:3b";
        const prompt = (req.payload?.prompt as string) ?? "";
        const body = JSON.stringify({
          model,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
          stream: false,
        });
        output = await shellExec(
          `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '${body.replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}'`,
          120000
        );
        break;
      }
      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown task: ${req.task}`);
    }

bash
cd ~/raymond-node
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

path = "src/index.ts"
with open(path) as f:
    content = f.read()

# Insert new cases before "default:"
addition = '''      case "ollama.list":
        output = await shellExec("curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/tags");
        break;
      case "ollama.chat": {
        const model = (req.payload?.model as string) ?? "qwen2.5:3b";
        const prompt = (req.payload?.prompt as string) ?? "";
        const body = JSON.stringify({
          model,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
          stream: false,
        });
        output = await shellExec(
          `curl -s -X POST http://localhost:11434/api/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '${body.replace(/'/g, "'\\\\''")}'`,
          120000
        );
        break;
      }
      default:'''

if "ollama.list" not in content:
    content = content.replace("      default:", addition, 1)
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write(content)
    print("Added ollama cases")
else:
    print("Already present")
PYEOF

bash

اگه کار کرد، اینا رو داری
قابلیت	روی Cloudflare	روی VPS
AI Chat (سریع)	✅ Workers AI	-
AI Chat (رایگان)	✅ OpenRouter	-
AI لوکال (مستقل)	-	✅ Ollama
Xray Proxy	-	✅ Reality
Node Agent	✅ DO	✅ Daemon
وقتی اینترنت بین‌الملل قطع شد:

Workers AI از دست می‌ره

OpenRouter از دست می‌ره

ولی Ollama روی VPS خودت کار می‌کنه (تا وقتی از ایران به VPS دسترسی داری)

مرحله بعدی — انتخاب کن
A) AI Router هوشمند

Workers AI + OpenRouter + Ollama رو یکپارچه می‌کنه

# ============================================================
# 1) Node-based AI provider (talks to VPS via Node Agent)
# ============================================================
@'
// AI provider that runs on a remote Raymond Node (VPS).
// Uses the Node Agent WebSocket to send tasks.

import type {
  AIProvider,
  AICompleteInput,
  AICompleteOutput,
  Env,
} from "../../core/contracts";
import { NodeClient } from "./node-client";

const DEFAULT_NODE_ID = "hetzner-nbg1-01";
const DEFAULT_MODEL = "qwen2.5:3b";

export class NodeAIProvider implements AIProvider {
  readonly id = "local-node";
  readonly name = "Local AI (VPS)";

  private nodeClient: NodeClient;
  private nodeId: string;

  constructor(env: Env, nodeId = DEFAULT_NODE_ID) {
    this.nodeId = nodeId;
    this.nodeClient = new NodeClient(env, nodeId);
  }

  async available(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const status = await this.nodeClient.status();
      return status.connected === true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  async complete(input: AICompleteInput): Promise<AICompleteOutput> {
    const started = Date.now();
    const model = input.model ?? DEFAULT_MODEL;

    // Build a single prompt from messages
    const prompt = input.messages
      .map((m) => {
        if (m.role === "system") return `System: ${m.content}`;
        if (m.role === "user") return `User: ${m.content}`;
        if (m.role === "assistant") return `Assistant: ${m.content}`;
        return m.content;
      })
      .join("\n\n");

    const result = await this.nodeClient.task<{
      stdout: string;
      stderr: string;
    }>("ollama.chat", { model, prompt }, 120000);

    if (!result.ok || !result.output) {
      throw new Error(result.error ?? "Node AI task failed");
    }

    // Parse Ollama JSON response
    const parsed = JSON.parse(result.output.stdout) as {
      message?: { content?: string };
    };
    const content = parsed.message?.content ?? "";
    if (!content) throw new Error("Empty response from local AI");

    return {
      content,
      provider: this.id,
      model,
      latencyMs: Date.now() - started,
    };
  }

  listModels(): string[] {
    return ["qwen2.5:3b", "qwen2.5:7b", "llama3.2:3b"];
  }

  defaultModel(): string {
    return DEFAULT_MODEL;
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\adapters\ai\node-ai.ts" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "  node-ai.ts" -ForegroundColor Green

# ============================================================
# 2) Node client — HTTP calls to Node Agent DO
# ============================================================
@'
// HTTP client for talking to a Raymond Node (via the Node Agent DO).

import type { Env } from "../../core/contracts";

export interface NodeStatus {
  connected: boolean;
  node?: {
    nodeId: string;
    info?: Record<string, unknown>;
    lastHeartbeat: number;
    connectedAt: number;
  };
}

export interface NodeTaskResult<T = unknown> {
  type: string;
  id: string;
  ok: boolean;
  output?: T;
  error?: string;
}

export class NodeClient {
  constructor(private env: Env, private nodeId: string) {}

  async status(): Promise<NodeStatus> {
    const id = this.env.NODE_AGENT.idFromName(this.nodeId);
    const stub = this.env.NODE_AGENT.get(id);
    const url = new URL("https://internal/status");
    const res = await stub.fetch(url.toString());
    return (await res.json()) as NodeStatus;
  }

  async task<T = unknown>(
    task: string,
    payload?: Record<string, unknown>,
    timeoutMs = 30000
  ): Promise<NodeTaskResult<T>> {
    const id = this.env.NODE_AGENT.idFromName(this.nodeId);
    const stub = this.env.NODE_AGENT.get(id);
    const url = new URL("https://internal/task");
    const res = await stub.fetch(url.toString(), {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ task, payload, timeoutMs }),
    });
    return (await res.json()) as NodeTaskResult<T>;
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\adapters\ai\node-client.ts" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "  node-client.ts" -ForegroundColor Green

# ============================================================
# 3) Registry update — local node first if requested
# ============================================================
@'
// AI Registry — chooses which provider to call.
//
// Selection priority:
//   1. explicit "provider" in the request (per-message override)
//   2. config default (stored in D1 settings, key = "ai.default_provider")
//   3. first available from: local-node → workers-ai → openrouter → ollama

import type {
  AIProvider,
  AICompleteInput,
  AICompleteOutput,
  AIProviderInfo,
} from "../../core/contracts";

export class AIRegistry {
  private providers = new Map<string, AIProvider>();
  private defaultProviderId: string | null = null;

  register(p: AIProvider): void {
    this.providers.set(p.id, p);
  }

  setDefaultProvider(id: string | null): void {
    this.defaultProviderId = id;
  }

  get(id: string): AIProvider | undefined {
    return this.providers.get(id);
  }

  async info(): Promise<AIProviderInfo[]> {
    const out: AIProviderInfo[] = [];
    for (const p of this.providers.values()) {
      out.push({
        id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        available: await p.available(),
        models: p.listModels(),
        defaultModel: p.defaultModel(),
        description: "",
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  async complete(
    input: AICompleteInput,
    preferredProvider?: string
  ): Promise<AICompleteOutput> {
    const available: AIProvider[] = [];
    for (const p of this.providers.values()) {
      if (await p.available()) available.push(p);
    }
    if (available.length === 0) throw new Error("No AI providers available");

    // Build priority order
    const priority: string[] = [];
    if (preferredProvider) priority.push(preferredProvider);
    if (this.defaultProviderId && this.defaultProviderId !== preferredProvider) {
      priority.push(this.defaultProviderId);
    }
    // Fallback chain
    for (const id of ["local-node", "workers-ai", "openrouter", "ollama"]) {
      if (!priority.includes(id)) priority.push(id);
    }

    const ordered: AIProvider[] = [];
    for (const id of priority) {
      const p = available.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (p) ordered.push(p);
    }

    let lastErr: unknown;
    for (const p of ordered) {
      try {
        return await p.complete(input);
      } catch (e) {
        lastErr = e;
        console.error(`AI provider "${p.id}" failed:`, e);
      }
    }
    throw lastErr ?? new Error("All AI providers failed");
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\adapters\ai\registry.ts" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "  registry.ts updated" -ForegroundColor Green

# ============================================================
# 4) Runtime update — register NodeAIProvider
# ============================================================
@'
// Runtime singleton for the current request.

import type { Env } from "./core/db";
import type {
  StorageContract,
  AuthContract,
  SecretsContract,
  EventsContract,
  TelegramContract,
} from "./core/contracts";
import { D1Storage } from "./adapters/storage/d1";
import { CloudflareSecrets } from "./adapters/secrets/cloudflare";
import { DbEventBus } from "./adapters/events/db-bus";
import { D1Auth } from "./adapters/auth/d1-auth";
import { AIRegistry } from "./adapters/ai/registry";
import { WorkersAIProvider } from "./adapters/ai/workers-ai";
import { OpenRouterProvider } from "./adapters/ai/openrouter";
import { OllamaProvider } from "./adapters/ai/ollama";
import { NodeAIProvider } from "./adapters/ai/node-ai";
import { MockTelegram } from "./adapters/telegram/mock";

interface Runtime {
  storage: StorageContract;
  secrets: SecretsContract;
  events: EventsContract;
  auth: AuthContract;
  ai: AIRegistry;
  telegram: TelegramContract;
}

let _runtime: Runtime | null = null;

export function initRuntime(env: Env): Runtime {
  if (_runtime) return _runtime;

  const storage = new D1Storage(env.DB);

  const masterKey = env.RAYMOND_MASTER_KEY;
  const secrets = new CloudflareSecrets(
    env as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
    storage,
    masterKey ?? "raymond-default-key-changeme"
  );

  const events = new DbEventBus(storage);
  const auth = new D1Auth(storage, masterKey ?? "raymond-default-key-changeme");

  const ai = new AIRegistry();
  ai.register(new NodeAIProvider(env));
  ai.register(new WorkersAIProvider(env.AI));
  ai.register(new OpenRouterProvider(env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY ?? null));
  ai.register(new OllamaProvider(env.OLLAMA_URL ?? null));

  const telegram: TelegramContract = new MockTelegram();

  _runtime = { storage, secrets, events, auth, ai, telegram };
  return _runtime;
}

export function getRuntime(): Runtime | null { return _runtime; }
export function getAuth(): AuthContract | null { return _runtime?.auth ?? null; }
export function getStorage(): StorageContract | null { return _runtime?.storage ?? null; }
export function getEvents(): EventsContract | null { return _runtime?.events ?? null; }
export function getAI(): AIRegistry | null { return _runtime?.ai ?? null; }
export function getTelegram(): TelegramContract | null { return _runtime?.telegram ?? null; }
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\runtime.ts" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "  runtime.ts updated (NodeAIProvider)" -ForegroundColor Green

# 6) Env interface — verify

@'
// D1 database helper

export interface Env {
  DB: D1Database;
  AI: Ai;
  ASSETS: Fetcher;
  TELEGRAM_PROXY: DurableObjectNamespace;
  NODE_AGENT: DurableObjectNamespace;
  ENVIRONMENT: string;
  APP_NAME: string;
  OPENROUTER_API_KEY?: string;
  OLLAMA_URL?: string;
  RAYMOND_MASTER_KEY?: string;
  NODE_SECRET?: string;
}

export async function queryFirst<T = unknown>(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<T | null> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  return (await stmt.first<T>()) ?? null;
}

export async function queryAll<T = unknown>(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<T[]> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  const result = await stmt.all<T>();
  return (result.results ?? []) as T[];
}

export async function run(
  db: D1Database,
  sql: string,
  ...params: unknown[]
): Promise<D1Result> {
  const stmt = db.prepare(sql).bind(...params);
  return await stmt.run();
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\core\db.ts" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "  db.ts verified" -ForegroundColor Green

لاگین کن

New chat

از picker بالای صفحه، Local AI (VPS) رو انتخاب کن

یه پیام بفرست مثل: Say hello in one line

اگه ۲۰-۴۰ ثانیه صبر کنی، جواب از AI لوکال روی VPS خودت میاد.

چیزی که الان داری
Provider	کجا	سرعت	مستقل؟
Workers AI	Cloudflare	سریع	❌
OpenRouter	خارج	سریع	❌
Local AI	VPS خودت	کند ولی کار می‌کنه	✅
حالا حتی اگه اینترنت بین‌الملل قطع شه، Local AI کار می‌کنه (تا وقتی به VPS دسترسی داری).

build + deploy + تست. نتیجه رو بفرست.

هنوز جواب نداده خیلی طول کشید 
طبیعیه. qwen2.5:3b روی CPU با ۲ هسته و ۴GB RAM کنده. برای جواب کوتاه، ۳۰-۶۰ ثانیه لازمه. برای جواب بلند، ممکنه ۲-۳ دقیقه.

بذار بفهمیم مشکل از کجاست:

مرحله ۱: تست مستقیم Ollama روی سرور (بدون واسطه)
توی SSH سرور:

bash
time curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/chat -d '{
  "model": "qwen2.5:3b",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Say hi in one line"}],
  "stream": false
}' | head -c 500
این می‌گه چقدر طول می‌کشه.

مرحله ۲: تست از PowerShell (با timeout طولانی)
powershell
$body = @{
  task = "ollama.chat"
  payload = @{
    model = "qwen2.5:3b"
    prompt = "Say hi in one line"
  }
} | ConvertTo-Json

Measure-Command {
  $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/node/hetzner-nbg1-01/task" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 300
  $r.output.stdout | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty message | Select-Object -ExpandProperty content
}
Measure-Command می‌گه چقدر طول کشید.

چرا کندی طبیعیه
مشکل: سرورت GPU نداره. qwen2.5:3b روی CPU با ۲ هسته یعنی:

سرعت: حدود ۵-۱۰ توکن در ثانیه

جواب کوتاه (۲۰ توکن): ۳-۵ ثانیه

جواب متوسط (۱۰۰ توکن): ۱۵-۳۰ ثانیه

جواب بلند (۵۰۰ توکن): ۱-۳ دقیقه

و هر درخواست از اول مدل رو لود می‌کنه (چون idle بعد از چند دقیقه unload می‌شه). لود مدل: ۲۰-۴۰ ثانیه.

راه‌حل‌ها
راه ۱: مدل کوچیک‌تر (سریع‌تر ولی ضعیف‌تر)
bash
ollama pull qwen2.5:1.5b
(۱GB، حدود ۲۰ توکن در ثانیه روی CPU)

یا حتی:

bash
ollama pull qwen2.5:0.5b
(۳۵۰MB، خیلی سریع، ولی فقط برای تست)

راه ۲: تنظیمات Ollama برای نگه‌داشتن مدل توی RAM
توی سرور:

bash
sudo systemctl edit ollama
اضافه کن:

text
[Service]
Environment="OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434"
Environment="OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=24h"
Environment="OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1"
Environment="OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1"
ذخیره و restart:

bash
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart ollama
اینطوری مدل همیشه توی RAM می‌مونه و هر بار لود نمی‌شه.

راه ۳: GPU اجاره‌ای (بعداً)
اگه خواستی سرعت واقعی، باید VPS با GPU بگیری (RunPod، Vast.ai) یا یه VPS با GPU روی Hetzner (CCX با GPU). این هزینه اضافه داره.

پیشنهاد من
برای الان:

۱. مدل qwen2.5:1.5b رو هم دانلود کن
۲. OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=24h رو تنظیم کن
۳. برای Local AI، از این مدل استفاده کنیم (سریع‌تره)
۴. qwen2.5:3b بمونه برای کارهای مهم‌تر

bash

sudo systemctl restart ollama

مرحله ۳: برگرد به پنجره tail
باید لاگ‌ها رو ببینی. مخصوصاً دنبال خطای ai-chat failed یا Event handler failed بگرد.

حدس من
احتمالاً یه چیزی مثل این توی tail می‌بینی:

text
Event handler failed for "chat.message.sent": TypeError: ...
یا

text
ai-chat failed: ...
با اون خطا می‌تونم دقیق fix کنم.

Ctrl+C توی tail بزن بعد از اینکه خروجی رو گرفتی.

یه چیز عجیب: هیچ درخواست POST /messages توی لاگ نیست. فقط GET‌ها (polling UI) دیده می‌شه.

یعنی پیامت اصلاً به Worker نرسیده. این یعنی $conv که استفاده کردی احتمالاً از یه conversation قدیمیه، یا $sess باطل شده.

بذار مستقیم تست کنیم:

توی PowerShell ویندوز:
powershell
# 1. لاگین تازه
$body = '{"username":"godfather","password":"پسوردخودت"}'
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/auth/login" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -SessionVariable sess
Write-Host "Login status: $($login.StatusCode)"

# 2. ساخت conversation جدید
$newConv = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations" -Method POST -WebSession $sess
$conv = $newConv.id
Write-Host "Conversation: $conv"

# 3. ارسال پیام
$msgBody = '{"content":"test local 3","provider":"local-node"}'
$sendResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations/$conv/messages" -Method POST -Body $msgBody -ContentType "application/json" -WebSession $sess
Write-Host "Send response:"
$sendResp | ConvertTo-Json
این رو بزن و همون لحظه برگرد به tail

POST https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations/conv_xxx/messages
اگه این خط رو دیدی، یعنی POST رسیده.

text

باید پسورد واقعی ریموندت رو بذاری، نه متن فارسی پسوردخودت.

مرحله ۱: لاگین با پسورد واقعی
powershell
$body = '{"username":"godfather","password":"پسوردِ-واقعیِ-ریموندت"}'
جای پسوردِ-واقعیِ-ریموندت رو با پسورد خودت عوض کن. همون که توی صفحه Setup ساختی.

مثلاً اگه پسوردت MySecret123 هست:

powershell
$body = '{"username":"godfather","password":"MySecret123"}'
بعد:

powershell
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/auth/login" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -SessionVariable sess
Write-Host "Login status: $($login.StatusCode)"

text

راه‌حل: پسورد رو از توی مرورگر روی موبایل یا لپ‌تاپت بذار:

۱. برو به https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev
۲. لاگین کن با همون پسورد
۳. بعد از ورود، برو روی Messenger یا هر چیز دیگه که auth می‌خواد
۴. اگه کار کرد، پسوردت درسته

بعد همون پسورد رو توی PowerShell بذار.

اگه پسوردت رو یادت نمیاد
راه ۱: اگه Recovery Code داری، می‌تونی پسورد رو ریست کنی.

راه ۲: از Chrome Password Manager یا هرچی که پسورد رو ذخیره کرده استفاده کن (توی لپ‌تاپ یا موبایل → Settings → Passwords → دنبال raymond).

راه ۳: اگه هیچی نداری، دیتابیس رو پاک می‌کنیم و از اول setup می‌کنی (چون هنوز هیچ داده مهمی توش نیست). این ۵ دقیقه‌ایه:

powershell
npx wrangler d1 execute raymond-db --remote --command "DELETE FROM users; DELETE FROM sessions; DELETE FROM recovery_codes; DELETE FROM login_attempts;"
بعد برو به اپ و setup جدید انجام بده.

اول پسورد واقعی رو بذار و لاگین کن. اگه 200 گرفتی، بگو تا بقیه مراحل رو بزنیم.

Write-Host "Login status: $($login.StatusCode)"

PS C:\Users\i\Downloads\reymond\raymond> Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations/$conv/messages" -WebSession $sess | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3

باز خالیه. یعنی POST اصلاً به event bus نمی‌رسه یا event bus خطا می‌ده قبل از اینکه user message رو ذخیره کنه.

بریم دقیق ببینیم. یه tail باز کن و همزمان یه پیام بفرست:

پنجره ۱: tail
powershell
npx wrangler tail --format=pretty
صبر کن تا Connected to raymond.

پنجره ۲: ارسال پیام
powershell
$msgBody = '{"content":"test 4","provider":"local-node"}'
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations/$conv/messages" -Method POST -Body $msgBody -ContentType "application/json" -WebSession $sess
برگرد به پنجره tail
دنبال این خطاها بگرد:

POST https://... → اگه نبود، یعنی request اصلاً نمیاد

Event handler failed → event bus خطا داده

ai-chat failed → AI خودش خطا داده

کل خروجی tail (فقط چند خط آخری که مربوط به POST هستن) رو کپی کن و بفرست.

اگه POST اصلاً توی tail نیست
یعنی درخواست به Worker نمی‌رسه. مشکل از $sess یا URL.

تست کنیم که $sess کار می‌کنه:

powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/auth/me" -WebSession $sess
باید ببینی:

text
id    type  name
--    ----  ----
user_xxx owner user_xxx
اگه Unauthorized داد، session خرابه.

این ۳ تا رو بزن:

Invoke-RestMethod /api/auth/me -WebSession $sess

Invoke-RestMethod /api/chat/conversations/$conv/messages ... POST

خروجی tail

همه رو برام بفرست.

دقت کن: tail هنوز روی conversation قدیمی (conv_551dccec...) داره polling می‌کنه. یعنی UI مرورگرت هنوز بازه و داره هر ثانیه check می‌کنه.

ولی تو داری برای conv_88e2bc47... (conversation جدید) پیام می‌فرستی. اگه POST رو بزنی، باید در کنار این GETها یه POST ببینی.

اما نمی‌بینم. یعنی POST اصلاً نمی‌رسه.

دلیل محتمل: اون $conv که توی PowerShell داری، احتمالاً از یه conversation دیگه‌ایه یا متغیر خراب شده.

این رو دقیق و کپی-پیست کن:
powershell
# 1. لاگین
$loginBody = '{"username":"godfather","password":"پسوردخودت"}'
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/auth/login" -Method POST -Body $loginBody -ContentType "application/json" -SessionVariable sess
Write-Host "1) Login: $($login.StatusCode)"

# 2. conversation جدید بساز
$newConv = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations" -Method POST -WebSession $sess
$conv = $newConv.id
Write-Host "2) Conversation: $conv"

# 3. پیام بفرست
$msgBody = '{"content":"hello from test","provider":"local-node"}'
$sendResp = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations/$conv/messages" -Method POST -Body $msgBody -ContentType "application/json" -WebSession $sess
Write-Host "3) Send:"
$sendResp

# 4. همین حالا check کن
Write-Host "4) Messages:"
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://raymond.myraymond2025.workers.dev/api/chat/conversations/$conv/messages" -WebSession $sess | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
مهم
پسوردخودت رو با پسورد واقعیت عوض کن (همونی که با Login status: 200 جواب داد).

چیزی که باید ببینی
مرحله ۳ باید بگه:

مرحله ۴ هم:

  "value": [

      "id": "msg_xxx",

      "content": "hello from test"
    }
  ],
  "Count": 1

اگه مرحله ۳ خطا داد، متن خطا رو بفرست.

اگه مرحله ۳ موفق بود ولی مرحله ۴ خالی بود، خروجی tail رو بفرست (همزمان که این اسکریپت رو می‌زنی tail باز باشه).

و یه نکته
توی مرورگرت، صفحه ریموند رو ببند. چون داره polling می‌کنه و tail رو شلوغ می‌کنه. از حالت Incognito یا پنجره دیگه استفاده نکن تا وقتی تست PowerShell تموم شه.

این ۴ مرحله رو پشت سر هم بزن و همه خروجی رو کپی کن بفرست.

پیدا شد! پسورد رو اشتباه نوشتی — علامت سوال فارسی وسطِ پسورد اومده:

text
password":"?سوردخودت"

But the key insight: POST returned ok: True — so the request reached the Worker. And the response is {ok: true}. This means bus.publish() was called.

So the request reached the route. The route called bus.publish(). But no message was stored.

Let me think about what bus.publish does:

INSERT into events table

await this.deliver(env, id) — this calls the handler

Handler chat.message.sent runs aiChatCapability.handle()

In handle: stores user message, gets history, calls AI, stores assistant message, etc.

Wait — the DB also has events table. If INSERT failed (e.g., no table), then bus.publish would throw and the POST would return 500. But POST returned 200/ok:true. So bus.publish succeeded.

But wait, the current implementation of ai-chat:

Looking at the code, when it's registered:

typescript
events.subscribe("chat.message.sent", (m) =>
  aiChatCapability.handle(m.payload as ChatMessagePayload)
);
BUT — the issue is that on every request, initRuntime is called. But _runtime is cached:

typescript
let _runtime: Runtime | null = null;

export function initRuntime(env: Env): Runtime {
  if (_runtime) return _runtime;
  ...
}
THERE'S THE BUG!

On the first request (cold start), _runtime is null, so it creates a new runtime and subscribes handlers.

On subsequent requests (warm), _runtime is not null, so it returns the cached one. aiChatCapability.register() is NEVER called again (because it's inside bootstrap() and bootstrapped = true). So the handlers ARE registered on the event bus.

BUT — here's the killer: the DbEventBus instances are per-request isolated. The _runtime stores ONE DbEventBus instance. If the request that sends the message gets a different _runtime (in a different isolate), the handler isn't registered.

Wait, _runtime is module-scoped, so within the same isolate it's the same. But Cloudflare Workers may spin up multiple isolates. Each isolate has its own _runtime.

The _runtime in the isolate that handled the POST might have been created fresh (no handlers registered because bootstrap() already ran in a different context) OR it might be cached from a previous request in the same isolate.

Actually wait. Let me re-read the code flow:

typescript
let bootstrapped = false;
async function bootstrap(env: Env): Promise<void> {
  if (bootstrapped) return;
  bootstrapped = true;
  registry.register(aiChatCapability.manifest);
  aiChatCapability.register();  // <-- this subscribes to event bus
  ...
}

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    await bootstrap(env);  // first request: registers
    initRuntime(env);      // first request: creates runtime + bus
    setEnv(env);
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
};
The issue: aiChatCapability.register() is called ONCE per isolate. And it calls:

typescript
register(): void {
  const events = getEvents();
  if (!events) {
    setTimeout(() => { ... }, 0);
    return;
  }
  events.subscribe("chat.message.sent", ...);
}
Ah-ha! aiChatCapability.register() is called BEFORE initRuntime() in the bootstrap flow.

Look:

typescript
export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    await bootstrap(env);     // <-- this calls aiChatCapability.register() but runtime not ready
    initRuntime(env);          // <-- this creates runtime
    ...
  }
}
So on the first request:

bootstrap(env) runs, sets bootstrapped = true, and calls aiChatCapability.register().

Inside register(), getEvents() returns null (because _runtime is still null).

So it goes into the setTimeout branch — which fires later, and the handler IS eventually subscribed.

THEN initRuntime(env) creates the runtime.

Handler is subscribed after setTimeout.

BUT bootstrapped = true means on subsequent requests, bootstrap() returns early. So register() is never called again.

That should still work IF the setTimeout fires after initRuntime. Let me check the code order:

typescript
let bootstrapped = false;
async function bootstrap(env: Env): Promise<void> {
  if (bootstrapped) return;
  bootstrapped = true;
  registry.register(aiChatCapability.manifest);
  aiChatCapability.register();  // <-- getEvents() returns null → setTimeout
  try { await registry.syncToDb(env); } catch ...;
}

app.all("*", async (c) => {
  return c.env.ASSETS.fetch(c.req.raw);
});

export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    await bootstrap(env);      // setTimeout queued
    initRuntime(env);          // now _runtime exists
    setEnv(env);
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
};
Then setTimeout fires → getEvents() returns the runtime's event bus → subscribes.

So in theory it works. But the issue is if setTimeout runs BEFORE initRuntime (unlikely but possible), or if the isolate that handles the POST is different from the isolate that ran bootstrap.

Hmm. Actually wait, there's another bug: initRuntime uses if (_runtime) return _runtime;. So if in the same isolate it was already initialized, it returns the cached one.

But if the isolate that handles the POST is fresh (cold start):

bootstrap() runs → subscribes via setTimeout

initRuntime() runs → creates runtime

If setTimeout fires before initRuntime, then the handler subscribes to an event bus that doesn't exist yet, or worse, getEvents() returns null.

Actually looking again:

typescript
register(): void {
  const events = getEvents();
  if (!events) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const e = getEvents();
      if (e) e.subscribe("chat.message.sent", (m) => aiChatCapability.handle(...));
    }, 0);
    return;
  }
  events.subscribe(...);
}
If setTimeout fires after initRuntime, then getEvents() returns the bus and subscribes. Good.

But the problem is: In a Cloudflare Worker, setTimeout may not fire at all if the request completes before it. Cloudflare Workers have very aggressive termination rules. If you finish the fetch and return the response, the isolate may be killed before setTimeout fires.

So the FIRST request (bootstrap) might complete and return without the handler ever being subscribed. Then subsequent requests in the same isolate NEVER subscribe because bootstrapped = true.

Actually, more importantly, the handler IS registered on the SAME isolate. But _runtime is per-module which is per-isolate. If it's the same isolate, getEvents() returns the same bus, and the subscription is active. So POST to /messages in the same isolate → bus.publish() → deliver → handler runs → stores message.

But if the request lands on a DIFFERENT isolate where bootstrapped = true was set on cold start and aiChatCapability.register() never ran, then the handler is not subscribed. So bus.publish() persists the event but delivers to zero handlers → returns.

THIS IS THE BUG.

Wait, bootstrapped is per-module too (per isolate). So if a new isolate starts, bootstrapped = false initially, then bootstrap runs, subscribes via setTimeout. But setTimeout may not fire.

Hmm, actually setTimeout in Cloudflare Workers... it does fire if the isolate stays alive. But if the isolate shuts down between requests, it might not.

The clean fix: register the handler synchronously in the same request flow, after initRuntime.

Let me restructure:

typescript
export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    initRuntime(env);          // 1. runtime first
    setEnv(env);
    if (!bootstrapped) {
      bootstrapped = true;
      registry.register(aiChatCapability.manifest);
      aiChatCapability.register();  // 2. now getEvents() works
      // sync to db in background
      ctx.waitUntil(registry.syncToDb(env).catch(console.error));
    }
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
};
But this doesn't solve the multi-isolate problem. In a new isolate, bootstrapped = false, so it registers again. Actually it DOES solve it: each isolate has its own bootstrapped variable, and on first request in each isolate, it registers. So the handler is registered in every isolate.

BUT the original code had this bug: bootstrap() was called BEFORE initRuntime(), and aiChatCapability.register() used getEvents() which returned null, then scheduled setTimeout. If setTimeout didn't fire, handler was never registered.

Also, the ORIGINAL order had initRuntime called at the END of fetch, but bootstrap ran before that:

Actually, re-reading the code I gave:

typescript
export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<Response> {
    await bootstrap(env);
    initRuntime(env);
    setEnv(env);
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
};
So bootstrap() runs first, calls aiChatCapability.register(). Inside, getEvents() returns null (because _runtime is still null). So it schedules setTimeout. Then initRuntime(env) creates the runtime. Then setTimeout fires (hopefully), subscribes.

BUT bootstrapped = true prevents re-registration on subsequent requests. And if setTimeout fails, registration never happens. And even if setTimeout succeeds on the first request, the second request might hit a different isolate where registration didn't happen.

The fix:

Call initRuntime(env) FIRST

Then register capabilities

Also, _runtime needs to be re-initialized if the env changes (it doesn't per isolate).

Actually the cleaner fix:

typescript
export default {
  async fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    // Initialize runtime first
    const runtime = initRuntime(env);
    setEnv(env);
    
    // Register capabilities once per isolate
    if (!bootstrapped) {
      bootstrapped = true;
      registry.register(aiChatCapability.manifest);
      aiChatCapability.register();  // getEvents() now returns valid bus
      // sync in background
      ctx.waitUntil(registry.syncToDb(env).catch(console.error));
    }
    
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
};
And aiChatCapability.register() will now find getEvents() non-null.

Let me write this fix.

Actually there's another possible issue: registry.syncToDb and bootstrapped interaction. If syncToDb fails silently, then capabilities table might not have the row. But that's a different issue.

Let me just give the fix focused on bootstrapped and ordering.

Also — the /node/ws error is because the Worker was redeployed and the WebSocket connection died. Node Agent should reconnect automatically (it has reconnect logic). So that's fine.

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

@'
// Raymond Worker entry point.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import { cors } from "hono/cors";
import type { Env } from "./core/db";
import { registry } from "./core/registry";
import { aiChatCapability, setEnv } from "./capabilities/ai-chat";
import { chatRoutes } from "./routes/chat";
import { systemRoutes } from "./routes/system";
import { authRoutes } from "./routes/auth";
import { telegramRoutes } from "./routes/telegram";
import { telegramWsRoutes } from "./routes/telegram-ws";
import { nodeRoutes } from "./routes/node";
import { initRuntime } from "./runtime";
import { requireAuth } from "./middleware/require-auth";

// Durable Objects
export { TelegramProxy } from "./do/telegram-proxy";
export { NodeAgent } from "./do/node-agent";

type Bindings = Env;
const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Bindings }>();

// CORS
app.use(
  "*",
  cors({
    origin: (origin) => origin,
    credentials: true,
  })
);

// No-cache for HTML/JS/CSS
app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
  await next();
  const path = new URL(c.req.url).pathname;
  if (
    path === "/" ||
    path.endsWith(".html") ||
    path.endsWith(".js") ||
    path.endsWith(".css")
  ) {
    c.res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate");
  }
});

// AI Chat capability — uses the runtime AI registry.

import { newId, now } from "../core/id";
import { audit } from "../core/audit";
import { queryAll, run } from "../core/db";
import type { Env } from "../core/db";
import type { Message } from "../../shared/types";
import { getAI, getEvents } from "../runtime";

export interface ChatMessagePayload {
  conversation_id: string;
  content: string;
  provider?: string;
  model?: string;
}

let _env: Env | null = null;
export function setEnv(env: Env): void { _env = env; }
export function getEnv(): Env | null { return _env; }

export const aiChatCapability = {
  manifest: {
    id: "ai-chat",
    name: "AI Chat",
    version: "0.5.0",
    description: "Chat with AI through the Router",
    events_subscribed: ["chat.message.sent"],
    events_published: ["chat.message.received"],
  },

  register(): void {
    const events = getEvents();
    if (!events) {
      console.error("ai-chat: cannot register — event bus not ready");
      return;
    }
    events.subscribe("chat.message.sent", (m) =>
      aiChatCapability.handle(m.payload as ChatMessagePayload)
    );
  },

  async handle(payload: ChatMessagePayload): Promise<void> {
    const env = _env;
    if (!env) {
      console.error("ai-chat: env not set");
      return;
    }

    const { conversation_id, content, provider, model } = payload;
    console.log(`ai-chat: handling ${conversation_id}, provider=${provider ?? "default"}`);

    try {
      // 1. Store user message
      await run(
        env.DB,
        "INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'user', ?, ?)",
        newId("msg"),
        conversation_id,
        content,
        now()
      );

      // 2. Load history
      const history = await queryAll<Message>(
        env.DB,
        "SELECT role, content FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 40",
        conversation_id
      );

      // 3. Call AI
      const started = now();
      let result: { content: string; provider: string; model: string };
      try {
        const ai = getAI();
        if (!ai) throw new Error("AI registry not ready");
        result = await ai.complete(
          {
            messages: history.map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
            model,
          },
          provider
        );
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("ai-chat: AI call failed:", err);
        await run(
          env.DB,
          "INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, provider, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'assistant', ?, 'error', ?)",
          newId("msg"),
          conversation_id,
          `[AI error] ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
          now()
        );
        return;
      }
      const latency = now() - started;

      // 4. Store assistant reply
      const assistantId = newId("msg");
      await run(
        env.DB,
        "INSERT INTO messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, provider, model, latency_ms, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'assistant', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        assistantId,
        conversation_id,
        result.content,
        result.provider,
        result.model,
        latency,
        now()
      );

      // 5. Bump conversation
      await run(
        env.DB,
        "UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        now(),
        conversation_id
      );

      // 6. Audit
      await audit(env, {
        actor: "owner",
        action: "chat.message",
        resource_type: "conversation",
        resource_id: conversation_id,
        metadata: { provider: result.provider, model: result.model, latency_ms: latency },
      });

      // 7. Publish event
      const events = getEvents();
      if (events) {
        await events.publish(
          "chat.message.received",
          { conversation_id, message_id: assistantId },
          "ai-chat"
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("ai-chat: fatal:", err);
    }
  },
};

@'
// Event Bus — modules communicate through events.
//
// Persistent (D1) + in-process delivery.

import { newId, now } from "./id";
import { queryAll, run } from "./db";
import type { Env } from "./db";
import type { RaymondEvent } from "../../shared/types";

export type EventHandler = (payload: unknown, event: RaymondEvent) => Promise<void>;

const handlers = new Map<string, EventHandler[]>();

export const bus = {
  register(topic: string, handler: EventHandler): void {
    const list = handlers.get(topic) ?? [];
    list.push(handler);
    handlers.set(topic, list);
    console.log(`[bus] registered handler for "${topic}" (total: ${list.length})`);
  },

  listTopics(): string[] {
    return Array.from(handlers.keys());
  },

  async publish(
    env: Env,
    topic: string,
    payload: unknown,
    source = "core"
  ): Promise<string> {
    const id = newId("evt");
    const subs = handlers.get(topic)?.length ?? 0;
    console.log(`[bus] publish "${topic}" (subs: ${subs})`);

    await run(
      env.DB,
      "INSERT INTO events (id, topic, payload, source, status, attempts, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', 0, ?)",
      id,
      topic,
      JSON.stringify(payload),
      source,
      now()
    );

    await this.deliver(env, id);
    return id;
  },

  async deliver(env: Env, eventId: string): Promise<void> {
    const evt = await queryAll<RaymondEvent>(
      env.DB,
      "SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1",
      eventId
    );
    if (!evt.length) return;
    const event = evt[0];

    await run(
      env.DB,
      "UPDATE events SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = ?",
      event.id
    );

    const list = handlers.get(event.topic) ?? [];
    console.log(`[bus] deliver "${event.topic}" to ${list.length} handlers`);

    let ok = true;
    let lastError: string | undefined;
    for (const handler of list) {
      try {
        await handler(JSON.parse(event.payload), event);
      } catch (err) {
        ok = false;
        lastError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        console.error(`[bus] handler failed for "${event.topic}":`, err);
      }
    }

    await run(
      env.DB,
      "UPDATE events SET status = ?, error = ?, processed_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
      ok ? "delivered" : "failed",
      lastError ?? null,
      now(),
      event.id
    );
  },
};

      );

          provider

        console.error("[ai-chat] AI call failed:", err);

          env.DB,

          newId("msg"),

      await audit(env, {

      });

      if (events) {
        await events.publish("chat.message.received", { conversation_id, message_id: assistantId }, "ai-chat");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[ai-chat] fatal:", err);
    }
  },

پیدا شد! خط کلیدی:

text
[bus] publish "chat.message.sent" (subs: 0)
[bus] deliver "chat.message.sent" to 0 handlers
یعنی subscribe اتفاق افتاده ولی توی یه instance دیگه از Worker بوده. Cloudflare Workerها multi-isolate هستن — handlers Map توی هر isolate جدا‌ست. یه isolate پیام رو publish می‌کنه، ولی subscribe توی isolate دیگه‌ایه.

راه‌حل: Event bus باید از Durable Object استفاده کنه که همیشه همون instance باشه. یا ساده‌تر: همون isolate رو مجبور کنیم همیشه یه چیز ثابت رو نگه داره.

ساده‌ترین راه: به جای Map in-memory، از D1 برای task queue استفاده کنیم. یعنی:

پیام chat.message.sent توی جدول events ذخیره می‌شه

یه Cron Trigger یا Queue اون رو پردازش می‌کنه

پردازش توی isolate دیگه‌ای هم کار می‌کنه چون D1 مشترکه

راه‌حل سریع‌تر: chat.ts مستقیم تابع handler رو صدا بزنه، نه از طریق event bus.

راه‌حل عملی (سریع): مستقیم صدا بزن
powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

@'
// Chat routes

import { Hono } from "hono";
import { newId, now } from "../core/id";
import { queryAll, run } from "../core/db";
import type { Env } from "../core/db";
import type { Conversation, Message } from "../../shared/types";
import { aiChatCapability } from "../capabilities/ai-chat";

export const chatRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

chatRoutes.post("/conversations", async (c) => {
  const id = newId("conv");
  const title = "New chat";
  await run(
    c.env.DB,
    "INSERT INTO conversations (id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
    id, title, now(), now()
  );
  return c.json({ id, title, created_at: now(), updated_at: now() });
});

chatRoutes.get("/conversations", async (c) => {
  const rows = await queryAll<Conversation>(
    c.env.DB,
    "SELECT * FROM conversations ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100"
  );
  return c.json(rows);
});

chatRoutes.get("/conversations/:id/messages", async (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param("id");
  const rows = await queryAll<Message>(
    c.env.DB,
    "SELECT * FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC",
    id
  );
  return c.json(rows);
});

chatRoutes.post("/conversations/:id/messages", async (c) => {
  const conversationId = c.req.param("id");
  const body = await c.req.json<{ content: string; provider?: string; model?: string }>();

  if (!body?.content?.trim()) {
    return c.json({ error: "content is required" }, 400);
  }

  console.log(`[chat] handling message for ${conversationId}, provider=${body.provider ?? "default"}`);

  // Run the AI chat handler directly (no event bus hop → same isolate)
  c.executionCtx.waitUntil(
    aiChatCapability.handle({
      conversation_id: conversationId,
      content: body.content,
      provider: body.provider,
      model: body.model,
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.error("[chat] handler error:", err);
    })
  );

  return c.json({ ok: true });
});

chatRoutes.delete("/conversations/:id", async (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param("id");
  await run(c.env.DB, "DELETE FROM conversations WHERE id = ?", id);
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\routes\chat.ts" -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "chat.ts rewritten (direct handler call)" -ForegroundColor Green
نکته مهم: waitUntil یعنی درخواست فوراً پاسخ داده می‌شه ولی handler توی background ادامه می‌ده
مشکل قبلی این بود که event bus توی isolate دیگه اجرا می‌شد. حالا مستقیم توی همون isolate اجرا می‌شه، پس subscribe/MWeahins مشکل حل می‌شه.

مرحله ۱: پسورد جدید رو هش کن

توی PowerShell (پوشه raymond):

powershell
node -e "
const crypto = require('crypto');
(async () => {
  const password = 'YOUR_NEW_PASSWORD_HERE';  // اینجا پسورد جدیدت رو بذار (قوی، 16+ کاراکتر)
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  const hash = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 100000, 32, 'sha256');
  console.log('HASH:' + hash.toString('base64'));
  console.log('SALT:' + salt.toString('base64'));
})();
"
جای YOUR_NEW_PASSWORD_HERE یه پسورد قوی بذار (ترکیب حرف بزرگ، کوچک، عدد، علامت، ۱۶+ کاراکتر).

مثلاً:

powershell
node -e "
const crypto = require('crypto');
(async () => {
  const password = 'Raymond#2026!Nikan';
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  const hash = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 100000, 32, 'sha256');
  console.log('HASH:' + hash.toString('base64'));
  console.log('SALT:' + salt.toString('base64'));
})();
"

⚠️ مشکل: TDLib یه wrapper Node.js لازم داره
TDLib یه کتابخانه C++ هست. برای استفاده از Node.js، یه wrapper لازمه:

دو راه:

راه A: prebuilt-tdlib — بسته npm که TDLib رو از قبل کامپایل‌شده دانلود می‌کنه. راحت‌تره، ولی معمولاً برای x86_64 Ubuntu 22.04 ساخته شده. Ubuntu 24.04 ممکنه سازگار نباشه.

راه B: tdl + کتابخانه دستی — خودت کامپایل کردی، tdl (پکیج npm) بهش وصل می‌شه.

پیشنهاد من: قبل از کامپایل ۳۰ دقیقه‌ای، اول راه A رو امتحان کنیم
چون سرورت Ubuntu 24.04 هست، بذار اول ببینیم prebuilt-tdlib کار می‌کنه یا نه. اگه کار کرد، از کامپایل خلاص می‌شیم.

توی SSH سرور:

bash
cd ~
mkdir -p raymond-telegram
cd raymond-telegram
npm init -y
npm install telegram tdl prebuilt-tdlib
اگه این بدون خطا نصب شد، بریم راه A.

اگه خطا داد، باید راه B (کامپایل) رو بریم.

مرحله بعد: پکیج Node.js برای TDLib
باید یه پکیج نصب کنیم که Node.js بتونه با TDLib حرف بزنه. دو تا گزینه:

A) tdl — پکیج قدیمی ولی کارکننده
B) prebuilt-tdlib + tdl — نسخه‌ی جدید، از پیش‌کامپایل‌شده

چون ما خودمون کامپایل کردیم، tdl تنها کافیه و به /usr/local/lib/libtdjson.so وصل می‌شه.

دستورات:
bash
cd ~
mkdir -p raymond-telegram
cd raymond-telegram
npm init -y
npm install tdl@7.4.0
بعد یه تست کوچیک
bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import { Client } from "tdl";

const client = new Client({
  apiId: 2040,
  apiHash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
  skipOldUpdates: true,
});

client.on("update", (update) => {
  console.log("Update:", update._);
});

console.log("TDLib client created. Trying to connect...");

setTimeout(() => {
  console.log("Done. TDLib loaded successfully.");
  process.exit(0);
}, 3000);
EOF
bash
node test-tdlib.mjs
چیزی که باید ببینی
اگه tdl درست به TDLib وصل شده:

text
TDLib client created. Trying to connect...
Done. TDLib loaded successfully.
اگه خطای مثل libtdjson.so: cannot open shared object file داد، یعنی مسیر library اشتباهه:

bash
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
بعد دوباره node test-tdlib.mjs رو بزن.

این دستورات رو بزن و خروجی node test-tdlib.mjs رو بفرست.

بعدش میریم سراغ ساخت:
۱. TDLib daemon (سرویس دائمی)
۲. اتصال به Node Agent (ریموند از راه دور بهش وصل شه)
۳. UI Messenger (چت واقعی روی ریموند)

آها، tdl@7.4.0 API جدید داره. باید apiId رو به شکل tdlibParameters بدی.

نسخه جدید تست رو بزن:
bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import { Client } from "tdl";

const client = new Client({
  tdlibParameters: {
    api_id: 2040,
    api_hash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
    system_language_code: "en",
    device_model: "Raymond",
    application_version: "0.1.0",
    system_version: "Linux",
    use_test_dc: false,
  },
  skipOldUpdates: true,
});

client.on("update", (update) => {
  console.log("Update:", update._);
});

console.log("TDLib client created. Trying to connect...");

setTimeout(() => {
  console.log("Done. TDLib loaded successfully.");
  process.exit(0);
}, 5000);
EOF
bash
node test-tdlib.mjs
چیزی که باید ببینی
text
TDLib client created. Trying to connect...
Update: updateAuthorizationState
Update: updateAuthorizationState
...
Done. TDLib loaded successfully.
اگه updateAuthorizationState دیدی، یعنی TDLib به سرورهای تلگرام وصل شد و منتظر شماره تلفنه. این همون چیزیه که می‌خوایم.

د داره options.tdlibParameters.api_id رو چک می‌کنه، ولی مقدار رو نمی‌بینه. عجیبه چون ما گذاشتیم.

احتمالاً tdl@7.4.0 یه API متفاوت داره. بذار یه چیز ساده‌تر امتحان کنیم:

اول بذار ساختار tdl رو ببینیم:
bash
cat node_modules/tdl/package.json | grep version
bash
sed -n '190,210p' node_modules/tdl/dist/client.js
خروجی رو بفرست تا بفهمم کد چی انتظار داره.

ولی بذار اول راه سریع‌تر امتحان کنیم:
bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import tdl from "tdl";

const client = tdl.createClient({
  apiId: 2040,
  apiHash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
});

console.log("Client created");

setTimeout(() => {
  console.log("Done");
  process.exit(0);
}, 5000);
EOF
bash
node test-tdlib.mjs
اگه بازم خطا داد، این رو امتحان کن:
bash
npm uninstall tdl
npm install tdl@8.0.0
بعد:

bash
node test-tdlib.mjs
اگه هیچ‌کدوم کار نکرد، برگرد به نسخه‌ای که در مستندات tdl هست:
bash
npm uninstall tdl
npm install tdl@7.0.0
خروجی این دستورات رو بفرست:

۱. cat node_modules/tdl/package.json | grep version

۲. sed -n '195,205p' node_modules/tdl/dist/client.js

با این می‌فهمم کدوم API رو استفاده می‌کنه و درست می‌نویسم.

عجیبه. کد چیزی رو چک می‌کنه که ما فرستادیم ولی نمی‌بینه.

بذار یه چیز ساده تست کنیم:

bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import { Client } from "tdl";

console.log("About to create client");
console.log("apiId = 2040");
console.log("apiHash = b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627");

try {
  const client = new Client({
    apiId: 2040,
    apiHash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
  });
  console.log("OK");
} catch (e) {
  console.log("ERROR:", e.message);
  console.log(e.stack);
}
EOF
bash
node test-tdlib.mjs
و این رو هم چک کن:
bash
node -e "console.log(typeof require('tdl').Client)"
bash
head -30 node_modules/tdl/dist/client.js
اگه همون خطا داد، این رو امتحان کن (bare mode):
bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import { Client } from "tdl";

const client = new Client({
  apiId: 2040,
  apiHash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
  bare: true,
});

console.log("Created in bare mode");

setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000);
EOF
bash
node test-tdlib.mjs
این ۳ تا رو بزن و خروجی هرکدوم رو بفرست:

۱. node test-tdlib.mjs (نسخه اول با try/catch)

۲. head -30 node_modules/tdl/dist/client.js

۳. node test-tdlib.mjs (نسخه bare mode)

با اینا می‌فهمم مشکل از کجاست.

خب بذار دقیقاً ببینیم چرا. کد tdl می‌گه options.apiId نیست، ولی ما apiId: 2040 می‌فرستیم.

بذار داخل کد tdl نگاه کنیم:

bash
sed -n '170,200p' node_modules/tdl/dist/client.js
و همچنین ببینیم چطور options رو می‌سازه:

bash
grep -n "_options =" node_modules/tdl/dist/client.js | head -5
راه سریع‌تر: بذار tdl رو با wrapper رسمی‌ش امتحان کنیم
پکیج tdl یه بسته همراه داره به اسم tdl-tdlib-addon که TDLib رو خودش مدیریت می‌کنه:

bash
npm uninstall tdl
npm install tdl tdl-tdlib-addon
بعد:

bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import { Client } from "tdl";
import { getTdjson } from "tdl-tdlib-addon";

const client = new Client({
  apiId: 2040,
  apiHash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
  tdjson: getTdjson(),
});

console.log("Client created");

setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000);
EOF
bash
node test-tdlib.mjs
اگه این هم کار نکرد، یه گزینه دیگه:
tdl نسخه جدیدش (7.x) رفتار متفاوتی داره. بذار این رو با نسخه 6 امتحان کنیم:

bash
npm uninstall tdl tdl-tdlib-addon
npm install tdl@6.9.0
بعد:

bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import { Client } from "tdl";

با اینا می‌فهمم tdl چطور options رو parse می‌کنه و مشکل از کجاست.

پیدا شد! مشکل از تایپ ماژول بود.

قبلاً tdl با import { Client } from "tdl" بارگذاری نمی‌شد درست. ولی خطای چک api_id می‌گفت که مشکل چیز دیگه‌ایه.

راه‌حل: با default import استفاده کن.

این تست رو بزن:
bash
cat > test-tdlib.mjs << 'EOF'
import tdl from "tdl";
import { getTdjson } from "tdl-tdlib-addon";

const { Client } = tdl;

const client = new Client({
  apiId: 2040,
  apiHash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
  tdjson: getTdjson(),
});

client.on("update", (u) => {
  console.log("Update:", u._);
});

console.log("Client created. Connecting...");

setTimeout(() => {
  console.log("Done");
  process.exit(0);
}, 6000);
EOF
bash
node test-tdlib.mjs

همون مشکل برای tdl-tdlib-addon. با default import بنویسش:

bash

import tdlPkg from "tdl";
import addonPkg from "tdl-tdlib-addon";

const { Client } = tdlPkg;
const { getTdjson } = addonPkg;

const client = new Client({
  apiId: 2040,
  apiHash: "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627",
  tdjson: getTdjson(),
});

client.on("update", (u) => {
  console.log("Update:", u._);
});

console.log("Client created. Connecting...");

setTimeout(() => {
  console.log("Done");
  process.exit(0);
}, 6000);
EOF

حالا ساخت daemon
یه سرویس دائمی می‌سازیم که:

TDLib رو نگه می‌داره

Node Agent با اون حرف می‌زنه

قدم ۱: ساخت فایل daemon
توی SSH سرور:

bash
cd ~/raymond-telegram
mkdir -p data
cat > daemon.mjs << 'EOF'
import tdlPkg from "tdl";
import prebuiltPkg from "prebuilt-tdlib";
import http from "node:http";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const { createClient } = tdlPkg;
const { getTdjson } = prebuiltPkg;

const API_ID = 2040;
const API_HASH = "b18441a1ff607e10a989891a5462e627";
const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
const PORT = 7070;

fs.mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });

const client = createClient({
  apiId: API_ID,
  apiHash: API_HASH,
  tdjson: getTdjson(),
});

// Track state
let authState = "unknown";
let lastError = null;
let me = null;
const chats = new Map();
const messages = new Map(); // chatId -> array

client.on("error", (err) => {
  console.error("[tdlib] error:", err);
  lastError = String(err);
});

client.on("update", (u) => {
  switch (u._) {
    case "updateAuthorizationState":
      authState = u.authorization_state?._ ?? "unknown";
      console.log("[tdlib] auth state:", authState);
      break;
    case "updateNewChat":
      if (u.chat) {
        chats.set(u.chat.id, {
          id: String(u.chat.id),
          title: u.chat.title ?? "",
          type: u.chat.type?._ ?? "unknown",
        });
      }
      break;
    case "updateNewMessage":
      if (u.message) {
        const chatId = String(u.message.chat_id);
        if (!messages.has(chatId)) messages.set(chatId, []);
        messages.get(chatId).push({
          id: String(u.message.id),
          text: u.message.content?.text?.text ?? "",
          date: u.message.date,
          out: u.message.is_outgoing,
        });
        if (messages.get(chatId).length > 200) messages.get(chatId).shift();
      }
      break;
    case "updateUser":
      break;
  }
});

// ============ HTTP API ============
const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  res.setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:${PORT}`);

  try {
    if (url.pathname === "/status") {
      res.end(JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        authState,
        lastError,
        me,
        chatsCount: chats.size,
      }));
      return;
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/login/phone") {
      const phone = url.searchParams.get("phone");
      if (!phone) { res.statusCode = 400; res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "phone required" })); return; }
      
      // Ensure client is ready before sending
      await client.ready();
      
      try {
        await client.invoke({
          _: "setAuthenticationPhoneNumber",
          phone_number: phone,
        });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, authState }));
      } catch (e) {
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String(e) }));
      }
      return;
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/login/code") {
      const code = url.searchParams.get("code");
      if (!code) { res.statusCode = 400; res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "code required" })); return; }
      try {
        await client.invoke({
          _: "checkAuthenticationCode",
          code,
        });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, authState }));
      } catch (e) {
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String(e) }));
      }
      return;
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/login/password") {
      const password = url.searchParams.get("password");
      if (!password) { res.statusCode = 400; res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "password required" })); return; }
      try {
        await client.invoke({
          _: "checkAuthenticationPassword",
          password,
        });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, authState }));
      } catch (e) {
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String(e) }));
      }
      return;
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/chats") {
      const list = Array.from(chats.values()).slice(0, 100);
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ chats: list }));
      return;
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/messages") {
      const chatId = url.searchParams.get("chatId");
      const list = messages.get(chatId) ?? [];
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ messages: list }));
      return;
    }

    if (url.pathname === "/me") {
      try {
        const u = await client.invoke({ _: "getMe" });
        me = {
          id: String(u.id),
          firstName: u.first_name ?? "",
          lastName: u.last_name ?? "",
          username: u.usernames?.active_usernames?.[0] ?? u.username ?? "",
          phone: u.phone_number ?? "",
        };
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: true, me }));
      } catch (e) {
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: String(e) }));
      }
      return;
    }

    res.statusCode = 404;
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: "not found" }));
  } catch (err) {
    res.statusCode = 500;
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: String(err) }));
  }
});

server.listen(PORT, "127.0.0.1", () => {
  console.log(`[daemon] listening on http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
  console.log("[daemon] waiting for TDLib auth...");
});

process.on("SIGTERM", async () => {
  console.log("[daemon] shutting down");
  try { await client.close(); } catch {}
  server.close();
  process.exit(0);
});
EOF

راه اول (ساده‌ترین و بدون هزینه): استفاده از API ID شخص دیگه
این راه حلی است که خیلی‌ها استفاده می‌کنن . چون api_id و api_hash فقط برای برنامه‌نویس (خودت) نیازه و به اکانت خودت گره نخورده، می‌تونی:

راه‌های گرفتن IP تمیز آمریکا:

اینترنت موبایل آمریکا (Roaming): اگه یه سیم‌کارت آمریکایی داری و رومینگش رو روشن کنی، IP تو از خود آمریکا میاد و تمیزترین راهه .

خرید پروکسی آمریکایی «Residential»: این پروکسی‌ها IP خونه‌های واقعی آمریکا رو می‌دن و تلگرام اون‌ها رو بلاک نمی‌کنه (برخلاف VPNهای معروف) .

استفاده از WarpOnWarp: یه ترفند برای اینکه IP ورکر رو تمیز کنی .

نکته مهم: باید با همون شماره آمریکایی که خریدی، هم داخل اپ تلگرام لاگین باشی، هم توی سایت my.telegram.org، و هم IP آمریکا باشه.

۲. my.telegram.org از IP ایران باز نمی‌شه. حتی با VPN هم ممکنه ERROR بده (که دادی).

۳. بعد از login، session باید روی VPS ذخیره بشه. اگه VPS ری‌استارت شه، session باید باقی بمونه. (این با database_directory حل می‌شه که هنوز تنظیم نکردیم)

۴. اگه تلگرام یه روز session رو باطل کنه (مثلاً بعد از ۶ ماه)، باید دوباره login کنی. این طبیعیه.

# ============================================================
# 1) Node routes
# ============================================================
@'
// Node management API — requires auth.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Env } from "../core/db";
import { NodeClient } from "../adapters/ai/node-client";

export const nodeApiRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

const NODE_ID = "hetzner-nbg1-01";

function client(env: Env): NodeClient {
  return new NodeClient(env, NODE_ID);
}

// GET /api/nodes — list nodes
nodeApiRoutes.get("/", async (c) => {
  const cli = client(c.env);
  try {
    const status = await cli.status();
    return c.json([
      {
        id: NODE_ID,
        name: "Hetzner Nuremberg",
        location: "Germany",
        connected: status.connected,
        info: status.node?.info ?? null,
        lastHeartbeat: status.node?.lastHeartbeat ?? null,
        connectedAt: status.node?.connectedAt ?? null,
      },
    ]);
  } catch (e) {
    return c.json({ error: (e as Error).message }, 500);
  }
});

// GET /api/nodes/:id/info — full system info
nodeApiRoutes.get("/:id/info", async (c) => {
  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task("system.info");
  return c.json(r);
});

// GET /api/nodes/:id/services — service states
nodeApiRoutes.get("/:id/services", async (c) => {
  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task("system.services");
  return c.json(r);
});

// GET /api/nodes/:id/disk
nodeApiRoutes.get("/:id/disk", async (c) => {
  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task("system.disk");
  return c.json(r);
});

// GET /api/nodes/:id/cpu
nodeApiRoutes.get("/:id/cpu", async (c) => {
  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task("system.cpu");
  return c.json(r);
});

// GET /api/nodes/:id/uptime
nodeApiRoutes.get("/:id/uptime", async (c) => {
  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task("system.uptime");
  return c.json(r);
});

// POST /api/nodes/:id/services/:service/restart
nodeApiRoutes.post("/:id/services/:service/restart", async (c) => {
  const service = c.req.param("service");
  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task("service.restart", { service }, 30000);
  return c.json(r);
});

// GET /api/nodes/:id/services/:service/status
nodeApiRoutes.get("/:id/services/:service/status", async (c) => {
  const service = c.req.param("service");
  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task("service.status", { service }, 20000);
  return c.json(r);
});

// POST /api/nodes/:id/task — generic task execution (for advanced users)
nodeApiRoutes.post("/:id/task", async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json<{
    task: string;
    payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
    timeoutMs?: number;
  }>();
  if (!body?.task) return c.json({ error: "task required" }, 400);

  // Whitelist of allowed tasks from the UI
  const allowed = [
    "system.info",
    "system.cpu",
    "system.disk",
    "system.uptime",
    "system.services",
    "service.restart",
    "service.status",
    "xray.users.list",
    "ollama.list",
    "ollama.chat",
    "ping",
  ];
  if (!allowed.includes(body.task)) {
    return c.json({ error: `Task not allowed: ${body.task}` }, 403);
  }

  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task(body.task, body.payload, body.timeoutMs ?? 60000);
  return c.json(r);
});
'@ | Set-Content -Path "src\worker\routes\node-api.ts" -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "  node-api.ts" -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host "  index.ts already has nodeApiRoutes" -ForegroundColor Yellow

@'
// Raymond Worker entry point.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import { cors } from "hono/cors";
import type { Env } from "./core/db";
import { registry } from "./core/registry";
import { aiChatCapability, setEnv } from "./capabilities/ai-chat";
import { chatRoutes } from "./routes/chat";
import { systemRoutes } from "./routes/system";
import { authRoutes } from "./routes/auth";
import { telegramRoutes } from "./routes/telegram";
import { telegramWsRoutes } from "./routes/telegram-ws";
import { nodeRoutes } from "./routes/node";
import { nodeApiRoutes } from "./routes/node-api";
import { initRuntime } from "./runtime";
import { requireAuth } from "./middleware/require-auth";

export { TelegramProxy } from "./do/telegram-proxy";
export { NodeAgent } from "./do/node-agent";

type Bindings = Env;
const app = new Hono<{ Bindings: Bindings }>();

app.use("*", cors({ origin: (origin) => origin, credentials: true }));

app.use("*", async (c, next) => {
  await next();
  const path = new URL(c.req.url).pathname;
  if (path === "/" || path.endsWith(".html") || path.endsWith(".js") || path.endsWith(".css")) {
    c.res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate");
  }
});

// Public WebSocket routes
app.route("/tg", telegramWsRoutes);
app.route("/node", nodeRoutes);

// Auth API
app.route("/api/auth", authRoutes);

// Auth-gated API
app.use("/api/*", requireAuth());

app.route("/api/chat", chatRoutes);
app.route("/api/system", systemRoutes);
app.route("/api/telegram", telegramRoutes);
app.route("/api/nodes", nodeApiRoutes);

app.get("/api", (c) => c.json({ app: c.env.APP_NAME ?? "Raymond", version: "0.6.0" }));
app.all("/api/*", (c) => c.json({ error: "Not found" }, 404));
app.all("*", async (c) => c.env.ASSETS.fetch(c.req.raw));

let bootstrapped = false;

function bootstrap(env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): void {
  if (bootstrapped) return;
  bootstrapped = true;

  initRuntime(env);
  setEnv(env);

  registry.register(aiChatCapability.manifest);
  aiChatCapability.register();

  ctx.waitUntil(
    registry.syncToDb(env).catch((err) => console.error("Registry sync failed:", err))
  );
}

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<Response> {
    bootstrap(env, ctx);
    return app.fetch(request, env, ctx);
  },
} satisfies ExportedHandler<Env>;

@'
// Node management API — requires auth.

import { Hono } from "hono";
import type { Env } from "../core/db";
import { NodeClient } from "../adapters/ai/node-client";

export const nodeApiRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>();

const NODE_ID = "hetzner-nbg1-01";

function client(env: Env): NodeClient {
  return new NodeClient(env, NODE_ID);
}

nodeApiRoutes.get("/", async (c) => {
  const cli = client(c.env);
  try {
    const status = await cli.status();
    return c.json([
      {
        id: NODE_ID,
        name: "Hetzner Nuremberg",
        location: "Germany",
        connected: status.connected,
        info: status.node?.info ?? null,
        lastHeartbeat: status.node?.lastHeartbeat ?? null,
        connectedAt: status.node?.connectedAt ?? null,
      },
    ]);
  } catch (e) {
    return c.json({ error: (e as Error).message }, 500);
  }
});

nodeApiRoutes.post("/:id/task", async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json<{
    task: string;
    payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
    timeoutMs?: number;
  }>();
  if (!body?.task) return c.json({ error: "task required" }, 400);

  const allowed = [
    "system.info",
    "system.cpu",
    "system.disk",
    "system.uptime",
    "system.services",
    "service.restart",
    "service.status",
    "xray.users.list",
    "ollama.list",
    "ollama.chat",
    "ping",
  ];
  if (!allowed.includes(body.task)) {
    return c.json({ error: `Task not allowed: ${body.task}` }, 403);
  }

  const cli = client(c.env);
  const r = await cli.task(body.task, body.payload, body.timeoutMs ?? 60000);
  return c.json(r);
});

# ============================================================
# 1) Node API client
# ============================================================
@'
// Node Manager API client.

const BASE = "/api/nodes";

async function req<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    ...init,
    credentials: "include",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(init?.headers ?? {}),
    },
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    throw new Error(`${res.status}: ${text.slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  return (await res.json()) as T;
}

export interface NodeListItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  location: string;
  connected: boolean;
  info: {
    hostname?: string;
    platform?: string;
    arch?: string;
    cpuCount?: number;
    memoryMb?: number;
    uptime?: number;
  } | null;
  lastHeartbeat: number | null;
  connectedAt: number | null;
}

export interface TaskResult<T = unknown> {
  type: string;
  id: string;
  ok: boolean;
  output?: T;
  error?: string;
}

export interface ServiceStates {
  services: Record<string, string>;
}

export const nodesApi = {
  list: () => req<NodeListItem[]>("/"),

  info: (id: string) =>
    req<TaskResult<Record<string, unknown>>>(`/${id}/info`),

  services: (id: string) =>
    req<TaskResult<ServiceStates>>(`/${id}/services`),

  disk: (id: string) =>
    req<TaskResult<{ stdout: string }>>(`/${id}/disk`),

  cpu: (id: string) =>
    req<TaskResult<{ stdout: string }>>(`/${id}/cpu`),

  uptime: (id: string) =>
    req<TaskResult<{ stdout: string }>>(`/${id}/uptime`),

  restartService: (id: string, service: string) =>
    req<TaskResult<{ stdout: string }>>(`/${id}/services/${service}/restart`, {
      method: "POST",
    }),

  serviceStatus: (id: string, service: string) =>
    req<TaskResult<{ stdout: string }>>(`/${id}/services/${service}/status`),
};

Write-Host "  api.ts" -ForegroundColor Green

@'
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { nodesApi, type NodeListItem, type ServiceStates } from "./api";

export function NodesApp() {
  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState<NodeListItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      const list = await nodesApi.list();
      setNodes(list);
      if (list.length > 0 && !selected) setSelected(list[0].id);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [selected]);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const iv = window.setInterval(load, 15000); // refresh every 15s
    return () => window.clearInterval(iv);
  }, [load]);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="nodes-app"><div className="nodes-loading">Loading nodes…</div></div>;
  }

  if (error) {
    return <div className="nodes-app"><div className="nodes-error">Error: {error}</div></div>;
  }

  if (nodes.length === 0) {
    return <div className="nodes-app"><div className="nodes-empty">No nodes registered.</div></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="nodes-app">
      <div className="nodes-list">
        {nodes.map((n) => (
          <div
            key={n.id}
            className={`node-card ${n.id === selected ? "active" : ""}`}
            onClick={() => setSelected(n.id)}
          >
            <div className="node-card-header">
              <span className={`node-status-dot ${n.connected ? "online" : "offline"}`} />
              <span className="node-card-name">{n.name}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="node-card-meta">
              <span>{n.location}</span>
              <span>{n.info?.cpuCount ?? "?"} CPU · {n.info?.memoryMb ?? "?"} MB</span>
            </div>
            <div className="node-card-id">{n.id}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="nodes-detail">
        {selected && <NodeDetail nodeId={selected} onRefresh={load} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function NodeDetail({ nodeId, onRefresh }: { nodeId: string; onRefresh: () => void }) {
  const [info, setInfo] = useState<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);
  const [services, setServices] = useState<ServiceStates["services"] | null>(null);
  const [disk, setDisk] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uptime, setUptime] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setError(null);
      const [infoRes, svcRes, diskRes, upRes] = await Promise.all([
        nodesApi.info(nodeId),
        nodesApi.services(nodeId),
        nodesApi.disk(nodeId),
        nodesApi.uptime(nodeId),
      ]);
      if (infoRes.ok) setInfo(infoRes.output as Record<string, unknown>);
      if (svcRes.ok && svcRes.output) setServices(svcRes.output.services);
      if (diskRes.ok && diskRes.output) setDisk(diskRes.output.stdout);
      if (upRes.ok && upRes.output) setUptime(upRes.output.stdout);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  }, [nodeId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    reload();
    const iv = window.setInterval(reload, 20000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(iv);
  }, [reload]);

  const restart = async (svc: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`Restart ${svc}?`)) return;
    setBusy(svc);
    try {
      await nodesApi.restartService(nodeId, svc);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000));
      await reload();
      onRefresh();
    } catch (e) {
      alert(`Restart failed: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`);
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  if (error) {
    return <div className="nodes-error">Error: {error}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="node-detail-content">
      <h2>{String(info?.hostname ?? nodeId)}</h2>

      <div className="node-section">
        <h3>System</h3>
        <div className="node-kv"><span>OS</span><span>{String(info?.platform ?? "?")} {String(info?.release ?? "")}</span></div>
        <div className="node-kv"><span>Architecture</span><span>{String(info?.arch ?? "?")}</span></div>
        <div className="node-kv"><span>CPU Model</span><span className="node-kv-truncate">{String(info?.cpuModel ?? "?")}</span></div>
        <div className="node-kv"><span>CPU Cores</span><span>{String(info?.cpuCount ?? "?")}</span></div>
        <div className="node-kv"><span>Node Version</span><span>{String(info?.nodeVersion ?? "?")}</span></div>
      </div>

      <div className="node-section">
        <h3>Services</h3>
        {services ? (
          Object.entries(services).map(([name, status]) => (
            <div key={name} className="node-service-row">
              <div className="node-service-info">
                <span className={`node-status-dot ${status === "active" ? "online" : "offline"}`} />
                <span className="node-service-name">{name}</span>
                <span className="node-service-status">{status}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                className="node-restart-btn"
                onClick={() => restart(name)}
                disabled={busy === name}
                title={`Restart ${name}`}
              >
                {busy === name ? "…" : "Restart"}
              </button>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="node-loading-text">Loading…</div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="node-section">
        <h3>Disk</h3>
        {disk ? (
          <pre className="node-pre">{disk}</pre>
        ) : (
          <div className="node-loading-text">Loading…</div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="node-section">
        <h3>Uptime</h3>
        {uptime ? (
          <pre className="node-pre">{uptime}</pre>
        ) : (
          <div className="node-loading-text">Loading…</div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
